We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

As Title Producer, you will ensure that members experience the highest quality dubbed audio and expertly crafted subtitles, preserving creative intent and enhancing the localized experience for viewers everywhere. With Netflix's ongoing international expansion, support for new languages, and the introduction of new content genres, providing world-class dubbing and subtitling services is essential to our success, making this an exciting time to join the company.

The Role

The Title Producer team will serve as the single point of accountability for the end-to-end localization process across all assigned titles in their country or slate. This role is responsible for orchestrating the seamless delivery of dubbing, subtitling, main/episodic titles, accessibility, and marketing assets, ensuring that all localized content reflects Netflix’s creative vision and meets regional standards for quality and authenticity. This role partners closely with internal and external stakeholders, including Content, Post, Marketing, external partners and more, to optimize workflows, resolve operational challenges, and drive continuous improvement. By championing operational excellence, this role plays a critical role in delivering a world-class member experience and supporting the successful global launch of Netflix content.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Localization Ownership

Fully own the operational and tactical localization lifecycle for assigned titles, serving as the single point of accountability from kickoff through global launch. 

Overseeing all language assets—including dubbing, subtitling, SDH, audio description, marketing supplementals, metadata, main/episodic titles, and forced narratives—proactively managing cross-functional expectations, timelines, budgets, quality control, and ensuring the launch readiness of localized assets for both long form and trailers.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

Act as the main point of strategic contact between Content, Post, Marketing, Launch Management, and other internal teams, ensuring alignment and seamless communication throughout the localization process.

Facilitate collaboration between Netflix, localization partners, and Language Producers to align timelines, deliverables, and quality standards. Oversee progress, resolve operational challenges, and ensure consistent, authentic localization that meets regional objectives.

Project & Workflow Management

Plan, schedule, and manage localization workflows for each assigned title, including setting the language suite strategy and vendor selection, bid management, financial tracking, and asset delivery.

Oversee context gathering, complexity assessment, source material distribution, and project tracking while maintaining operational efficiency, ensuring our localization partners are set up to create localized assets that meet the Netflix creative standard.

Analyze localization metrics and project data to identify opportunities for workflow optimization and to proactively resolve operational challenges.

Quality, Risk, and Issue Management

Identify, assess, and manage project risks, as well as troubleshoot and escalate quality or operational issues as needed, to keep projects on track.

Analyze title level localization metrics and data to identify opportunities for workflow optimization and to proactively resolve operational challenges.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Champion the adoption of new practices, workflows, automation, and technology to streamline localization processes and support the integration of emerging media types (live, video podcasts, interactive experiences, etc.).

Identify and flag challenges within the current workflow to support ongoing operational improvement.

Foster a culture of partnership, transparency, and continuous improvement within the team and with external partners.

Requirements

5 or more years of project management experience in a high-demand, fast-paced environment, ideally in the entertainment industry; experience managing large-scale, cross-functional projects in a fast-paced environment.

Ability to handle a fast-paced environment, supervising several projects at various points of production (from development through delivery).

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills; able to work effectively in collaboration with creative, operational, and technical teams.

Make sound independent decisions, and know when to escalate issues

Highly analytical, data-driven, and solutions-oriented; able to identify root causes, optimize processes, and drive operational excellence.

Adaptable and resilient in the face of change and ambiguity; comfortable with evolving priorities and new challenges.

Passion for operational efficiency or project management.

Fluency in English required; additional languages a plus.

Netflix derives a significant competitive advantage from the analytical approach it takes to manage all aspects of the business. As we continue to push for growth and retention in the UCAN (US & Canada) region, we are looking for an Associate to join our Partnerships F&S team. This role will be focused on analyzing partnership opportunities with local operators (e.g. T-Mobile, Verizon, Comcast) in North America and conducting global partnership analyses / projects. 

Partnerships are a critical driver of growth for Netflix. The most common types of partnerships with local operators are bundles. These impact millions of members, and our analyses play a critical role in the assessment and ongoing strategy for those partnerships in the region. During negotiations, we provide guidance to the Business Development team using data and analysis. When partnerships are launched, we monitor their performance and search for best practices and areas of improvement. Finally, we work closely with our Product and Partner Engagement teams to determine which changes in the Netflix experience could improve the partnerships’ impact. 

This role will be based in Los Gatos and report to the UCAN Manager of Partnerships, F&S. It may include limited travel (a few days per year) to partner locations in North America.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Evaluating the financial impact of partnership opportunities (primarily bundles): 

Financial projections and scenario modeling 

Risk identification and mitigation strategies 

Advising the Business Development team during the negotiations 

Analyzing the performance of partnerships to extract actionable insights (e.g. best practices, areas of improvement) 

Conducting global analyses regarding bundle performance 

Creating insightful presentations that facilitate decision-making for internal stakeholders and external partners 

Partnering with the Product team to help identify/prioritize and assess the impact of initiatives (e.g. improving Netflix plan upgrades for bundles) 

Providing inputs to other teams working on partnerships initiatives (e.g. Data Science & Engineering, Consumer Insights, Marketing) 

Developing industry expertise for the US and Canada

QUALIFICATIONS

Candidates are required to be highly analytical and effective communicators. Prior experience in management consulting or an equivalent analytical role is strongly preferred. Ideal candidates will have a proven track record of performing comprehensive analyses independently and proactively. They must thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess a high level of intellectual curiosity, focus on generating results and exhibit the highest standards of integrity and ethics. 

Ideal experience:

3-5 years of experience, ideally in management consulting or a similar field

Extensive experience conducting quantitative analysis that leads to actionable insights

Team player with strong interpersonal skills, but also able to work independently 

Adept at managing multiple projects and stakeholders 

Skilled in preparing effective presentations with clear narratives 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Strong Excel skills are required

Proficiency with Tableau and SQL is a strong plus

Bachelor’s degree with emphasis on coursework of a quantitative nature

We are looking for a finance and operations professional to help us scale our operations and elevate how we run source-to-pay at Netflix. The Finance Procurement Operations (FPO) team supports Netflix’s Source-to-Pay processes - how we source, procure, and pay our partners around the world. Within FPO, the Strategic Operations team is a strategic thought partner to leaders; we drive alignment across FPO, project-manage big cross-functional bets, drive impact and results, and help prioritize the FinTech and engineering work that powers our operations.

We’re looking for a Program Analyst to help us scale how we work. 

The ideal candidate for this role is someone with a solid understanding of the S2P workflow, experience in project management, a process-innovation mindset, and a passion for developing strong cross-functional relationships. This position will be based in our Los Angeles office and report to the Strategic Operations Manager. 

Responsibilities:

Work closely with Program Leads and FPO leadership to support programs and strategies that improve our global operations.

Help define how we measure success for key programs: baselines, targets, and impact

Support FPO strategies and programs by providing project management support

Manage project plans, timelines, status updates, and escalations/risk to ensure everyone is aligned and the project is on track

Drive follow-through on decisions and action items with stakeholders across time zones.

Use data and process insight to identify what’s working, what’s not, and where we should focus.

FinTech / Systems Prioritization Support: 

Help translate operational needs into clear requirements and input to engineering and product teams (e.g., Workday Financials, workflow tools, support tools).

Review FPO-driven FinTech projects and perform prioritization and impact analysis to determine what Engineering works on

Support UAT and rollout for new features or tools, and help track adoption and impact.

Support change management: communications, training materials, FAQs, and light enablement for process or tool changes.

Qualities We’re Looking For

3-6 years of experience in Operational Finance, Finance/Procurement Operations, Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, or Program/Project Management 

Familiarity with S2P workflows (requisitions, POs, invoices, payments, vendor setup/management) is a plus.

You’re analytically minded - comfortable working with data (Excel/Sheets, basic BI tools), spotting patterns, and turning numbers into insight.

You’re a structured problem-solver who can bring order to ambiguity and break big problems into manageable pieces.

You’re organized and able to juggle multiple workstreams without dropping details.

You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, and you’re comfortable drafting concise decks and memos for different audiences.

You enjoy understanding how things actually work end-to-end, and you’re motivated to make them better.

You build strong relationships and are effective in a cross-matrixed, global environment.

Experience with tools like Workday Financials, SmartSheets, Tableau, Freshdesk, or AI solutions is a plus, but not a requirement. You learn new tools quickly.

The Opportunity 

The Casting Business Affairs Team at Netflix is seeking an experienced professional for an associate role to support the US/Canada/UK Scripted Series group. Members of this team are the subject matter experts on engaging guest performers, stunt performers, singers and dancers to work on Netflix's award winning scripted series. 

The Role

In Casting Business Affairs you will play a primary role in structuring, negotiating, and drafting guest performer deals and agreements, collaborating with internal and external partners to oversee the entire process necessary for guest performers on a production. This includes coordinating with casting, business and legal affairs, production, accounting, post-production, credits, residuals, and other internal and external teams throughout all stages of a series from pre-production to production and post-production. Your adaptability and capacity to work proactively under tight timeframes will be crucial as you navigate this dynamic environment that is ever changing. Candidates should embrace and advocate for cultural diversity while upholding the highest standards of professionalism and integrity. 

Responsibilities

Work closely with external casting to advise on deal structure and strategy for guest performers.

Serve as the primary point of contact between Netflix and talent agents and attorneys regarding guest performer agreements.

Review and approve project-specific guest performer deals, ensuring accuracy, signatures, and payment details.

Advise and educate producers, casting, production, finance, post-production, and business affairs teams (in-house and external partners) on the requirements under SAG-AFTRA (and/or other performer union) contracts.

Work closely with in-house Creative Casting to provide optimal support to external partners.

Provide guidance to post-production regarding cast contract requirements when modifying scenes, including moving, splitting, and deleting scenes, as well as ADR/Loop Group payments.

Coordinate with Screen Credits, Residuals, and Legal Delivery teams to maintain an efficient workflow.

Willingness to work on new subjects outside area of expertise, take on special projects, and support all areas of the Casting Business Affairs Team as the need arises

Requirements

High proficiency in contract review, structuring, and drafting, as well as negotiating complex talent/performer agreements.

Experience with SAG-AFTRA, ACTRA and/or UBCP Collective Bargaining Agreements

Familiarity with the production process and the key players

Exhibit sound judgment and adept critical thinking skills in various situations, enabling effective problem-solving and decision-making.

Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills 

Preferred

BA/BS degree, JD applicants welcome 

Comprehensive knowledge of SAG rules and deal structures for guest performers

Experience with Google Suite, i.e., Google Docs, Google Sheets

In April 2022, we introduced a new, more affordable, ad-supported tier for our customers, marking a significant milestone for Netflix. Our focus is now on expanding choices for consumers and providing advertisers with a premium TV brand experience that surpasses traditional linear formats. The challenge ahead involves scaling our ad tech to maximize its impact on our business.

Our Team

The Ads Platform Engineering teams build advertising systems and integrations that power the delivery of ads using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads - unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state of the art content delivery system, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving, members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

The Creatives Team is building the robust, scalable backbone that powers all creative workflows across the Netflix Ads platform. The ability to scale how quickly advertisers are able to bring their creatives, get them processed, reviewed and deployed to reach the right member on our platform is crucial for our success. This team will build out our creative infrastructure that works across our broadening supply sources (SVOD, Live and FTAB), enables scalability and sophistication (leveraging the best in class ML / genAI algorithms) and manages effective distribution for ad decisioning and serving even as we bring in more cardinality and flexibility of units that span a large variety of devices. 

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a rapidly evolving space, enabling autonomy in the CTV marketplace. If you're passionate about high-impact work, cutting-edge ad tech, and contributing to a global product, we invite you to help us define the next era of advertising at Netflix.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

Deep Expertise in Distributed Systems: Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable distributed systems. This includes a strong understanding of concurrency, parallel processing, and microservices architecture.

Fluency in at least one core Programming Languages - Java, Python or Go with a history of writing production-quality, well-tested code.

Operational Excellence and Observability: Experience with setting up and maintaining comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting systems (e.g., using tools like Spinnaker, Prometheus, Grafana, or proprietary solutions) to ensure system reliability and quick diagnosis of issues.

Proven Problem-Solving Capability: The ability to tackle complex, ambiguous technical problems and develop pragmatic, long-term solutions.

Strong Collaboration and Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. A history of successfully collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., Product Management, Design, and other Engineering teams) is necessary.

Ownership and Drive: A proactive mindset and a strong sense of ownership over the entire software development lifecycle, from initial design through deployment, operations, and eventual deprecation.

Nice to Haves:

Experience in the Ads Domain: prior experience building or operating infrastructure specifically for digital advertising, including creative management, ad serving, or campaign optimization platforms, is a significant advantage.

Experience with creative lifecycle management and pipeline development.

Experience with machine learning applications in advertising, particularly in ad review systems.

Experience building large-scale infrastructure for real-time, low-latency online advertising environments.

Knowledge of the CTV space and its unique constraints.

Key to the effort to build a global internet TV network is the ability to grow and evolve our revenue-generating initiatives worldwide. We continue to introduce new commerce models, pricing strategies, and other opportunities to grow the business, and now you have the chance to join the growing team of finance experts who support them. Our Revenue team is seeking a Collections Analyst to support our Credit & Collections function. This newly created position will look to resolve complex issues and consequently improve the speed of collections across our business lines, such as Advertising, Partnerships, and Consumer Products. This role will be based in New York but will work cross-functionally across many time zones with our US and other international offices.

 

The perfect candidate will be hands-on and thrive when engaging directly with customers and business partners. They will be an excellent communicator who is comfortable speaking directly with senior management both with our customers and also within our internal teams. They will have the ability to negotiate and adapt to a multitude of different and ever-changing scenarios, always finding a pathway to a positive resolution.

 

They will be very detail-oriented, able to analyze and action a large volume of requests & transactions with high accuracy, and be capable of multitasking and taking the initiative to drive process change and improvements.

 

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 

Ensure that Netflix is paid on time by reviewing aging reports and worklists regularly to identify and follow up on overdue balances in a timely manner.

Reach out to customers with overdue balances via phone, email, or written communication to ensure timely payment. Maintain a professional, courteous, and solution-focused approach when addressing late payments.

Foster strong customer relationships to ensure future payments are received on time and disputes are minimized.

Provide exceptional levels of customer service and professionalism in customer interactions whilst also ensuring company interests are protected.

Be a trusted business partner and provide exceptional service levels when interacting with internal Netflix teams and colleagues.

Ensure detailed notes are kept on all interactions with the customer, including any requests for payment, disputes, agreements, and commitments.

Provide regular account reviews/account updates to your manager.

Escalate ‘problem accounts’ in good time to your manager and business partners to assist in issue resolution.

Prepare support packages for accounts being forwarded for write-offs, 3rd-party collection, legal action, bankruptcy filings, etc., as needed.

Address and resolve in real time, where possible, any disputes related to outstanding balances. Work with the customer and internal teams (Dispute Management, Sales, Legal, etc.) to ensure dispute resolution.

Manage and maintain changes to customer contact information, addresses, and other critical billing and reporting details.

Ensure remittance details for incoming payments are received and that the Cash Applications team has the information needed to successfully post cash.

Manage portal billing as required by the customers.

Support monthly accounting close activities as needed.

Assist in the development of strategies to reduce delinquency rates, increase the speed of payment, and minimize bad debt by analyzing past-due accounts, identifying trends, process gaps, and making recommendations for process improvements.

 QUALITIES WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

Deep knowledge and understanding of Accounts Receivable and Collections processes.

Thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume transaction environment.

Comfortable engaging in direct conversations with customers and internal business partners, including senior management.

Ability to maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail in preparing and entering financial information.

Customer Service-oriented person who focuses on quality communication with high levels of professionalism.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in other languages (Spanish / Portuguese) is a plus.

Highly motivated with the ability to work independently.

Forward-looking thinker who does not simply accept the status quo but can articulate the need for and contribute to process Improvement and positive change.

Works with a sense of urgency and sensitivity to last-minute, highly critical business requests.

Uses good judgment and knows when to make a decision and when to escalate.

Exemplifies the Netflix Culture.

 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree (Finance-related a plus)

At least 4 years of experience in a collections environment.

Experience in communicating directly with customers

Proven ability to handle high volumes of collection activities in a fast-paced environment

Experience at a Global Company

Knowledge of cloud-related ERP systems is a plus (Workday, HighRadius, Salesforce)

About the Role:

The Physical Production Legal team is seeking a dynamic Associate/Associate Counsel to join our team primarily to support the Eyeline business and scripted live-action series as needed. This role requires a proactive individual with a keen understanding of industry standards and deal contexts who can manage and execute various legal functions related to physical production with moderate oversight. The ideal candidate will have a background in below-the-line production legal matters and be highly collaborative with internal and external partners. 

Responsibilities include:

Serve as point of contact for below-the-line legal matters arising from Eyeline Studio.

Structure, draft, and negotiate below-the-line production agreements with moderate oversight, ensuring alignment with Netflix and industry standard and deal contexts (e.g., vendor/rental agreements; equipment rental agreements; post-production agreements and visual effects agreements).

Clearly and succinctly communicate solutions to internal production and business partners as well as external producers and production personnel.

Efficiently resolve issues without causing delays, adapting to the fast-paced nature of production legal work.

Exercise sound judgment and curiosity regarding matters of first impression or complex issues.

Requirements:

The successful candidate will have an undergraduate degree (JD or Paralegal certification accepted, but not required) and at least 3 years of proven experience in a similar business/legal affairs role in the film or television industry. This candidate must also be able to work proactively and reliably on multiple projects under tight timeframes in a fast-paced production environment being able to quickly assess risk and exercise strong judgment in the face of ambiguity. 

The successful candidate will also possess the following:

Demonstrated leadership capabilities and a solutions-driven mindset.

The ability to organize, clarify, and communicate complex ideas quickly, succinctly and accurately. 

Confidence in counseling business partners and making decisions that have legal & business impacts.

The ability to remain flexible and respond positively to changes.

Tech-savvy individual, including proficiency with Google Suite and cloud-based document and database systems.

Ability to flourish in our unique ​​company culture, reflecting our values and leadership expectations.

Position Summary

We are seeking CG Experimental Artists to join our pioneering team creating animated shorts and specials using experimental GenAI-native production pipelines. Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with a team of CG and Generative AI experts to develop unique content for animated shorts and specials, leveraging a GenAI-native pipeline that combines generative AI tools with traditional animation techniques.

Contribute to the creation of short stories in a fast-paced, sprint-based production environment.

Actively participate in creative discussions and brainstorming sessions.

Use GenAI tools such as ComfyUI to generate concept frames, style frames, character explorations, and environment designs based on scripts, outlines, or verbal direction.

Experiment with and evaluate the latest generative tooling and be open to testing new technology throughout the development process.

Create shot-ready assets (e.g., characters, props, environments) using a combination of generative tools and traditional DCCs (Photoshop, Maya, Houdini, Harmony, Blender, etc.).

Build and fine-tune generative image and video models.

Test and compare multiple generative tools and workflows (e.g., different models, LoRAs, motion tools), document results, and recommend best practices to the team.

Experience with ComfyUI and traditional CG 2D and/or 3D DCCs such as Photoshop, Maya, Houdini, Harmony, and/or Blender.

Experience with creating and animating assets (terrains, layout, characters, control-rigs, lighting) within Unreal Engine.

Ability to help develop character and visual designs that align with the desired style and sensibility, focusing on character personality, mood, and tone.

Strong conceptual understanding of diffusion-based rendering and animation techniques. Experience training image LoRAs, video LoRAs, and similar are a plus.

Strong collaborative skills and ability to work in a team environment with Directors, Producers, and technology leads, often in rapidly evolving, experimental pipelines.

Passion for storytelling and animation with a portfolio showcasing the ability to create compelling narratives using AI tools. Ability to adapt to new technologies and tools and quickly pivot in this fast-moving field where workflows and creative approaches are being developed in real time.

High level of independence and initiative, as production support structures and workflows will be evolving alongside the creative process.

The Role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on MLOps, deployment, and performance optimization to help bridge the gap between research and production in the gaming space. You will work cross-functionally with games technical directors, designers, and scientists to ensure that novel AI-driven game concepts can be deployed efficiently across a variety of hardware environments.

Build and maintain MLOps pipelines: Develop robust CI/CD for ML, model registries, and automated deployment workflows to support rapid iteration.

Framework Proficiency: Extensive experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.

Strong Software Engineering: Ability to develop high-quality, maintainable code and integrate complex algorithmic solutions into production systems.

Hands-on experience deploying ML models on edge, such as iOS or Android devices, including model optimization and hardware-aware inference.

Experience in game development and familiarity with game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal).

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building an in-house world-class ad tech ecosystem to offer our members more choices in consuming their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.

Our Team

The Ads Engineering team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business. This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution. This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.

We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time. Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip, comfort with lofty goals and big ambitions, the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.

We are looking for engineers to join us on this journey, to be a part of some exciting initiatives, and the talented teams who work on realizing our ambitious vision.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

Well grounded domain experience in any of the following areas: Ad Serving, Ads Identity & Audiences, Ads Creatives, Inventory & Forecasting, Campaign Management, Media Planning, Measurement, Reporting, or Ads Finance.

General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape. 

Worked closely with ad operations to enable campaign setup, targeting, reporting and advertiser needs. 

Developed many cloud based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object oriented),

Familiar with A/B testing and experimentation.

Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

Nice to haves:

Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of it’s unique constraints

Spotlight on Ads Engineering Teams:

The Ad Supply team manages the policies and technical integrations for third-party ad supply. While Netflix has traditionally licensed content, we're exploring this alternative funding model. The team solves complex challenges, such as determining how both Netflix and the third-party partner can sell ad inventory for the same content without conflict. They establish clear rules for inventory sharing, campaign setup, and system configurations to ensure consistency and fairness.

The Ads Measurement team builds systems that enable advertisers on Netflix to quantify campaign outcomes. Leveraging a blend of Netflix innovations and both first-party and third-party solutions, we deliver ads that respect the viewing experience while driving impactful results for advertisers. Our tools empower advertisers to effectively measure and analyze these outcomes.

The Ads Identity and Audience team is dedicated to delivering a relevant and engaging advertising experience while prioritizing consumer privacy. Our mission is to maintain precise subscriber identities to ensure that ads are not only engaging but also respectful of consumer privacy choices and regional regulations. We maintain a high-quality Identity Graph, which is used for various purposes, including respecting privacy choices and regulations, audience onboarding, targeting, measurement, and reporting.

The Ads Creatives & Policy team at Netflix is at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that enhance the ad experience for both viewers and advertisers. We are responsible for managing the lifecycle of ad creatives, ensuring compliance with policies, and leveraging cutting-edge technology to optimize ad delivery. Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your contributions directly impact the viewing experience of millions worldwide.

The Ads Media Planning team is at the heart of designing and delivering state-of-the-art media planning solutions that power Netflix’s advertising business. We are developing innovative, in-house ad tech systems that enable advertisers and internal partners to efficiently plan, allocate, and optimize media investments across Netflix’s platform. Our technology translates advertiser objectives into actionable media plans, ensuring seamless integration, automation, optimization, compliance, and management of media strategies at scale. We work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust media planning capabilities that serve our advertisers, members, and Netflix’s broader business goals.

The Live Ads Management team is driving one of Netflix’s most exciting frontiers — bringing advertising to Live Events. We’re building the intelligence that powers ad experiences during some of Netflix’s biggest real-time moments, from live sports to global specials. Our team develops smart, scalable capabilities that help ad operations plan, set up, and deliver ads seamlessly during live broadcasts. We’re pushing the boundaries with automated manifest generation, machine learning–driven optimizations, and agentic workflows that adapt in real-time to maximize both monetization and viewer experience. We work hand in hand with creative, streaming, and ads engineering teams to make advertising on Netflix Live feel effortless — blending storytelling, technology, and real-time decisioning into one unforgettable experience. It’s a fast-moving, high-visibility team shaping how live entertainment and advertising come together on a global stage.

The Ads Platform Foundations team builds the core platforms, frameworks, and shared services that accelerate development across the Ads organization. We focus on enabling teams to move faster and build consistently through scalable UI infrastructure, common components, and foundational workflows. Our work also powers access control across domains and underpins core systems such as Public API, GenAI foundations, and the Ads Entity Service — a knowledge graph connecting all Ads entities. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

The Ads Campaign Management team is responsible for our in-house Order Management System (OMS) used by our account managers to facilitate the booking and execution of advertising campaigns on behalf of Agencies, Brands, and Advertisers. The team owns key parts of our campaign hierarchy (Orders, Line Items) and closely intersects with almost every other team across Ads Engineering (Creatives, Forecasting, Audiences, Measurement, Ad Serving, etc) as well as business teams across Account Management and Ad Operations to facilitate the set-up, execution, and monitoring of ads across the Netflix ecosystem. 

The Ads Inventory Management & Forecasting team builds state-of-art real-time inventory forecasting solutions leveraging ML models and high-performance ad server simulations. The team also builds systems that enable publisher inventory management solutions, which support various monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split, and yield optimization.

The Ads Data Clean Room team is redefining how clean rooms are used in digital advertising. We’re building data collaboration tools as internal services, allowing multiple teams to share data with external partners in a convenient and privacy-safe way. Our scope extends beyond traditional clean room use cases to include novel integrations where data has traditionally been shared more openly. As the ads data landscape evolves, our team will continue to lead by creating new ways to enable collaboration while protecting privacy.

The Ads Finance team’s vision is to establish a compliant, accurate, automated, and omni-channel Finance and billing system that streamlines and optimizes financial operations for ads, with a core charter to create a unified and compliant Revenue Recognition layer, Automate billing, Invoicing and Journal processes. The Ads Finance platform centralizes and validates all the raw data—from campaign performance to pricing structures—needed to calculate and bill our diverse advertising revenue streams. This ensures financial integrity and consistency, providing a reliable foundation for all core Ad business operations, including budgeting, predicting future revenue, and managing credit and pricing strategies.

The Ads Eventing team builds and operates the foundational systems that collect, validate, enrich, and deliver ads-related events at a massive scale. These high-throughput data pipelines ingest raw signals from client devices (TV, mobile), server-side ad insertions, and external third-party integrations. The core mission is to transform these raw signals into clean, reliable, and privacy-safe data streams, ensuring data quality and fidelity across the board. This critical infrastructure directly powers all core downstream functions, including real-time ad serving decisions, robust measurement and attribution systems, and financial reconciliation and billing workflows.

The Ads Reporting Infrastructure team is responsible for delivering the final, actionable data to stakeholders. Their focus is on building the systems that consume validated and enriched ads delivery data to power the comprehensive reporting surfaces used by internal teams and advertisers to analyze campaign performance and business outcomes. They ensure the data presented is accurate, timely, and easy to consume, enabling key functions like measurement and attribution analysis, financial reconciliation, and strategic decision-making based on business results.

The Ads CRM team delivers the AI-powered Go-to-Market platform, the strategic engine for Netflix Ads sales and marketing. We don't just collect customer data; we create a unified, enriched view of our customers and their ad spend across every source, managing the entire lifecycle for impeccable quality and completeness. Our intuitive UI and intelligent automation agents surface critical, actionable insights, empowering our sales teams to cut through the noise, focus on high-value client engagements, and accelerate the success of Netflix Ads.

The Netflix Ads Identity, Signals and Audiences team is committed to providing a relevant and engaging advertising experience that prioritizes member privacy. Our mission is to maintain accurate member identities and curate valuable Signals and Audiences ensuring that ads are engaging, optimized and compliant with consumer privacy choices and regional regulations.

The Role

As a Software Engineer on the Ads Identity, Signals and Audiences team, you will be instrumental in designing and developing Netflix Conversion APIs. These APIs are essential for powering critical Measurement, Optimization, Retargeting and Reporting capabilities. Your responsibilities will include building high-volume, low-latency services capable of ingesting consented user engagement events from Advertiser properties in near-real-time. This ingestion will support various methods, including server-to-server streaming, pixel requests, and batch uploads. You will join a skilled team of professionals dedicated to ads technology and user privacy, collaborating within a culture that strongly promotes continuous learning, diversity, and creativity.

Required Experience and Skills:

Conversion API and Event Processing: Demonstrated experience in building server-to-server, batch and pixel Conversion APIs. This includes processing conversion events from diverse sources to create high-fidelity, identity and attribution-enriched, and deduplicated "gold" data sets for consumption by downstream services.

Unlocking Conversion Value: Expertise in leveraging conversion events to enable valuable derivative services, such as retargeting and outcome-based optimization.

Streaming Architectures: Practical experience with streaming event architectures and related technologies (e.g., Kafka, Flink).

Ad Tech and Privacy Knowledge: Strong understanding of the ad technology and advertising landscape, including programmatic advertising and current digital marketing trends. Familiarity with global ads regulations, as well as privacy, consent, and legal compliance.

Collaboration and Communication: Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to work collaboratively across diverse, cross-functional teams.

Adaptability: Ability to thrive and effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

Nice to Haves:

Familiarity with clean rooms and industry-leading privacy-enhancing technology for multi-party data sharing.

Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints.

The Role

This is an exciting opportunity to join a new team and build a dedicated Design System from the ground up. We are seeking highly skilled UI Engineers to build and drive the foundational Design System for Netflix's Commerce business domain. We are hiring multiple engineers across both the Web and TV platforms.

The role will be centered on:

Component Development: Designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality, production-ready, accessible, and performant UI components. This work is primarily focused on building React-based design system components.

Technology Stack: The role requires deep expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, the React framework, and modern CSS frameworks to deliver reusable component libraries.

AI First Development: Develop AI-driven tools that benefit both our own development workflow and the efficiency of those who use our design system.

Platform Scope: Our components must maintain a consistent experience across multiple platforms, so prior experience with UI development on any TV UI platform is a significant plus for the roles that will contribute to the TV platform.

Strategy & Roadmaps: Work closely with System Designers and Product Design leadership to define, set, and implement the technical roadmap for the Commerce Design System.

Collaboration: The engineer will partner with Commerce experience designers and Core Design System engineers to integrate core components, design tokens, and APIs, and with product teams to drive the successful adoption of the components into various product spaces.

Adoption & Enablement: Collaborate with product engineering teams to drive successful adoption of Design System components into their respective product spaces.

The Team

You will join a new, high-impact team dedicated specifically to the Commerce domain design system. The Commerce Domain owns a large and mission-critical surface area of the Netflix product, encompassing the user's entire journey from initial engagement to ongoing membership. This includes vital touchpoints such as user acquisition, login and authentication, account and identity management, the home page and landing pages, payment processing, and partner flows. Your work provides the foundational building blocks for product engineers who build these products every day.

This team operates at the intersection of design and engineering, focused on creating scalable, high-quality, and accessible user interfaces that drive the business. You will work side-by-side with System Designers, Product Design, and cross-functional product engineering teams. Your work will directly influence the development efficiency, visual quality, and usability of features that millions of Netflix users interact with globally.

The engineers you will be working with on the team are not only exceptionally talented but also deeply supportive and collaborative. We believe in providing the best environment for success, and a core part of our mission is to enable other product engineering teams to succeed by providing them with a robust design system. 

What’s Different About Us

Scale, Impact

Hundreds of Engineers: You’ll be a part of a team that improves UI development velocity for over 100 engineers.

Millions of Users: creates best-in-class UIs used by over 300M subscribers and billions of visitors.

Thousands of Devices: across a wide spectrum of devices...

Globally: in almost every country in the world.

Unique Technical Challenges
We build design system solutions that are flexible enough to support a wide range of use cases across diverse client and server environments, while remaining ergonomic and easy to use for the engineers we support.

Collaboration and Communication
It’s not all about the tech. We highly value the skills required to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively.

Freedom, Responsibility, Ownership
We believe in providing engineers with the business context they need, and then giving them the freedom and responsibility to define project scope, define/debate architecture, determine trade-offs, and figure out the implementation details.

Our Culture
Lastly, but most importantly, we live by our values.

What Sets You Apart

Design Systems Expertise: Prior experiences building and maintaining high-quality, scalable Design Systems.

Tools & Testing: Hands-on experience with component documentation tools like Storybook and visual regression tools like Chromatic.

AI Native Mindset: Champion an AI-first development mindset, actively pushing the boundaries of AI's potential in our products and workflows.

Production Readiness: Deep understanding and experience with the full software development lifecycle, including building, testing, releasing, and supporting your code in a production environment.

Server Driven UI: Experiences in building front-end UIs in a Server Driven UI architecture.

People who do well on the team are self-starters with a proactive approach to problem-solving, a drive to own projects end-to-end, and a passion for driving technology innovation rooted in business and customer needs. But more importantly, we look for engineers who understand that there are rarely any absolutes when it comes to technology. The ability to engage in meaningful discussions with colleagues about use cases, prioritization, and technical challenges, while thoughtfully weighing trade-offs across multiple solutions, is a skill we value highly.

If this resonates with you, we’d love to talk!

The Globalization team at Netflix is looking for an Internationalization Engineer to help shape how Netflix works for audiences everywhere. In this role, you will partner closely with engineering and product teams across the company, serving as a subject matter expert on internationalization best practices while architecting, building, and championing solutions that scale globally. You will not just fix issues, you will define the standards and systems that power Netflix’s international experience.

This is a lean, highly collaborative team based primarily in Los Gatos, CA. If you are excited about owning internationalization at a company with bold global ambitions and helping stories travel the world seamlessly, we would love to talk.

Responsibilities

Serve as an internationalization evangelist across Netflix, raising the internationalization IQ of engineering, design, and product teams company-wide.

Champion the adoption of ICU and CLDR standards throughout the organization and help teams use them effectively.

Define and drive the internationalization roadmap, communicating priorities and progress clearly to all stakeholders.

Partner closely with Product Managers to ensure business decisions align with internationalization best practices from day one.

Provide hands-on technical leadership to product and engineering teams, applying deep knowledge of internationalization standards and global-ready architecture.

Embed with product teams to help internationalize code, externalize localizable content, and improve overall localizability.

Build backend services, frontend applications, and automation tools to support global scale when needed.

Design and implement internationalization tooling and conformance checks at code submission and build time.

Develop, maintain, test, debug, and deploy production-ready internationalization libraries used across Netflix.

Required skills

Proven experience in internationalization engineering, especially for web platforms and integrating internationalization frameworks into production systems.

Strong foundation in software design and architecture, data structures, and algorithms, with an eye toward building elegant, global-ready systems.

Experience delivering scalable, highly available, high-performance applications.

Passion for contributing to open source, ideally within the ICU and CLDR ecosystems.

Clear, confident communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical partners.

Deep expertise in JavaScript, Node.js, and React, with expert-level Java knowledge and strong internationalization best practices across the stack.

Hands-on experience building full-stack systems on AWS.

Extensive experience with Spring Boot and Gradle in production environments.

Comfort using modern development tools, web services, and advanced scripting techniques.

Proven ability to externalize and manage localizable content stored in databases.

Experience designing internationalization tooling and automation for continuous localization workflows.

Background integrating enterprise localization platforms into build and CI systems to enable continuous localization cycles.

Thorough understanding of Unicode, ICU4J, CLDR, and related internationalization standards.

Practical experience leveraging AI to accelerate and improve software development.

About Studio Tech Solutions (STS)

For Netflix Studio to continue to scale and produce quality content, the Studio business teams work closely with product partners to innovate and develop technical solutions that support the entire content life cycle - planning, programming, producing, distributing and promoting content on a global scale. These solutions include internal enterprise applications that support critical functions, as well as short-term technical solutions that increase operational efficiency at the business user level on a smaller, rapidly iterative scale. STS works directly with business stakeholders, cross-functional product teams, and engineering partners to deliver these short-term solutions. The team's goal is to translate business challenges and opportunities for operational improvement into focused, nimble, and highly impactful solutions as an integral part of the Netflix Studio product and enterprise ecosystem.

About the Role

As a Solutions Software Engineer (L5) on the STS team, you'll be a part of a co-located team working out of the Los Angeles office. You'll use a broad set of internal and third-party technology and tools to contribute to highly targeted and adaptable solutions that increase operational efficiency within the Content Planning and Finance area of the Netflix Studio business. Your key areas of focus will be data ingestion and export, development of workflow automations and prototypes, third-party integrations, and contribution to the existing enterprise applications. You will interface with business users, analyze their needs, design and develop a solution, or leverage existing technology/tools with customized enhancements. Most of the solutions involve data ingestion or export tasks. While we value your ability to create well-defined systems, your effectiveness will be related to your ability to context switch effectively while developing nimble solutions for the business.

Your effectiveness in this role will be related to:

Your ability to learn quickly and switch contexts productively in a highly collaborative development environment.

Your curiosity to gain business and technical context to determine the efficient level of engineering investment for project scope.

Your eagerness to share learning and project visibility with the team, partners, and stakeholders.

Having a keen eye for identifying the team’s productivity tooling opportunities and working with partners to influence their feature roadmap.

You'll thrive in this role if:

You are passionate about solving problems and love every aspect of the full-stack software development life cycle.

You understand the importance of seeking in-depth and broad context to build an effective solution.

You enjoy building prototypes and short-term solutions to help improve and empower users to innovate on business workflows.

You are comfortable contributing to solutions at all technical levels, from scripting to building a custom application.

You are able to pivot and iterate quickly on solutions and share learnings with partnering teams in a cross-functional environment.

You are highly collaborative and enjoy building strong internal and cross-functional partnerships.

You have a passion for learning and professional growth.

4+ years of experience in full-stack development.

Comfortable working with: Node.js, Python or Java.

React or similar front-end frameworks.

Experience with API integrations (GraphQL, REST and/or gRPC).

Experience working with non-technical business stakeholders

The Team

The Studio Media Algorithms team is at the forefront of algorithmic innovation to enhance and support the creation of Netflix’s entertainment content, including games. In this role, you will be embedded within this team while collaborating very closely with a specialized Games Studio R&D team. This incubation-style team is chartered to lead our investments in building new kinds of games leveraging emerging technologies to support our creators and reach player audiences in new ways.

The Role

We are seeking a Machine Learning Scientist to lead the research and development of Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and multi-modal foundations and solutions for games. This role is defined by a mandate for inference efficiency; you will not only build and fine-tune state-of-the-art models but also lead the algorithmic innovation required to make them viable in terms of cost, latency, and quality across a variety of cloud and edge devices.

You will work in close partnership with our Machine Learning Engineers to bridge the gap between "research-grade" models and high-performance deployment, with your focus being on algorithmic optimization—ensuring that our language, visual, and audio models are architecturally optimized for real-time interaction and efficiency.

Responsibilities

Model Adaptation & Alignment: Design and own the fine-tuning and alignment of LLMs and VLMs in PyTorch, leveraging modern preference learning and reinforcement learning to enhance reasoning, tool-use, and agentic workflows for interactive game systems.

Algorithmic Model Optimization: Lead efforts in model compression—specifically knowledge distillation, structural pruning, and architectural refinement—to create efficient variants of large models that meet strict latency, cost, and quality constraints.

Generative Visuals & Diffusion: Develop and optimize Diffusion-based models for Image, Video, and 3D generation, including distillation and efficiency techniques for viable game-time performance.

Pragmatic Model Integration: Strategically evaluate and integrate SOTA open-source and commercial models while building internal "layers," adapters, and enhancements to fill gaps in creative control.

Multi-modal Interaction: Optimize and integrate audio (ASR/TTS), language, and vision models to enable low-latency, cross-modal reasoning and interaction.

About You (Requirements)

Multi-modal Architecture Expertise: Strong foundation in deep learning architectures, with deep expertise in Transformers and Diffusion architectures powering LLMs, VLMs, and generative visuals, including their specific performance bottlenecks.

Optimization Specialist: Proven track record in algorithmic model optimization (e.g., distillation, quantization-aware training, or pruning) to reduce FLOPs and memory footprint.

Data-Centric Mindset: Skilled in data cleaning, curation, and the creation of synthetic data for complex evaluation and training pipelines.

Pragmatic Builder: Ability to prioritize impact by deciding when to use commercial APIs/OSS weights versus when to invest in proprietary R&D to solve efficiency or quality problems.

Programming: Expert proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch); ability to collaborate with engineering on low-level performance constraints.

Bonus Experience

Prior experience optimizing models for heterogeneous hardware (Mobile, Cloud GPU, and custom edge devices).

Expertise in audio-visual multimodal models and video generation.

Job Description

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building an in-house world-class ad tech ecosystem to offer our members more choices in consuming their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.

We wrapped up our first two years of the journey and are well into year three with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

The Ads Engineering team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business. This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution. This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.

We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time. Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip, comfort with lofty goals and big ambitions, the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.

We are looking for engineers to join us on this journey, to be a part of some exciting initiatives, and the talented teams who work on realizing our ambitious vision.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

Well grounded domain experience in any of the following areas: Ad Serving, Ads Identity & Audiences, Ads Creatives, Inventory & Forecasting, Campaign Management, Media Planning, Measurement, Reporting, or Ads Finance.

General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape. 

Worked closely with ad operations to enable campaign setup, targeting, reporting and advertiser needs. 

Developed many cloud based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object oriented),

Familiar with A/B testing and experimentation.

Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

Nice to haves:

Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of it’s unique constraints

Spotlight on Ads Engineering Teams:

The Ads Member Experience team is part of the core Ads Serving group and is responsible for building and serving the different ad formats available on the platform. The team owns the integration between the different Netflix clients (TV, mobile app, web) and the ads serving infrastructure. One of its primary goals is to optimize how different ad formats are integrated with the Netflix member experience, in order to better serve both our users and our advertisers.
 
The Ads Programmatic team at Netflix is responsible for the strategic development and operational execution of programmatic advertising within the Netflix Ad Server ecosystem. This team focuses on building third-party demand integrations to maximize programmatic channels, driving significant advertising revenue for Netflix, while ensuring positive performance and value delivery for advertising partners. The team is dedicated to building a world-class programmatic advertising ecosystem that significantly contributes to the overall success of Netflix's advertising business.
 
The Ads Media Planning team is at the heart of designing and delivering state-of-the-art media planning solutions that power Netflix’s advertising business. We are developing innovative, in-house ad tech systems that enable advertisers and internal partners to efficiently plan, allocate, and optimize media investments across Netflix’s platform. Our technology translates advertiser objectives into actionable media plans, ensuring seamless integration, automation, optimization, compliance, and management of media strategies at scale. We work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust media planning capabilities that serve our advertisers, members, and Netflix’s broader business goals.

The Ads Platform Foundations team builds the core platforms, frameworks, and shared services that accelerate development across the Ads organization. We focus on enabling teams to move faster and build consistently through scalable UI infrastructure, common components, and foundational workflows. Our work also powers access control across domains and underpins core systems such as Public API, GenAI foundations, and the Ads Entity Service — a knowledge graph connecting all Ads entities. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

The Ads Campaign Management team is responsible for our in-house Order Management System (OMS) used by our account managers to facilitate the booking and execution of advertising campaigns on behalf of Agencies, Brands, and Advertisers. The team owns key parts of our campaign hierarchy (Orders, Line Items) and closely intersects with almost every other team across Ads Engineering (Creatives, Forecasting, Audiences, Measurement, Ad Serving, etc) as well as business teams across Account Management and Ad Operations to facilitate the set-up, execution, and monitoring of ads across the Netflix ecosystem. 

The Ads Inventory Management & Forecasting team builds state-of-art real-time inventory forecasting solutions leveraging ML models and high-performance ad server simulations. The team also builds systems that enable publisher inventory management solutions, which support various monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split, and yield optimization.

The Ads Data Clean Room team is redefining how clean rooms are used in digital advertising. We’re building data collaboration tools as internal services, allowing multiple teams to share data with external partners in a convenient and privacy-safe way. Our scope extends beyond traditional clean room use cases to include novel integrations where data has traditionally been shared more openly. As the ads data landscape evolves, our team will continue to lead by creating new ways to enable collaboration while protecting privacy.

The Ads Finance team’s vision is to establish a compliant, accurate, automated, and omni-channel Finance and billing system that streamlines and optimizes financial operations for ads, with a core charter to create a unified and compliant Revenue Recognition layer, Automate billing, Invoicing and Journal processes. The Ads Finance platform centralizes and validates all the raw data—from campaign performance to pricing structures—needed to calculate and bill our diverse advertising revenue streams. This ensures financial integrity and consistency, providing a reliable foundation for all core Ad business operations, including budgeting, predicting future revenue, and managing credit and pricing strategies.

The Ads CRM team delivers the AI-powered Go-to-Market platform, the strategic engine for Netflix Ads sales and marketing. We don't just collect customer data; we create a unified, enriched view of our customers and their ad spend across every source, managing the entire lifecycle for impeccable quality and completeness. Our intuitive UI and intelligent automation agents surface critical, actionable insights, empowering our sales teams to cut through the noise, focus on high-value client engagements, and accelerate the success of Netflix Ads.

Over 108 million people tuned in to watch the fight between Jake Paul and Mike Tyson, and more than 65 million people watched the NFL games live on Christmas Day in 2024. At Netflix, our live events create cultural moments, and we have very exciting Live events lined up for the next few years. 

To support Netflix’s vision for Live, the streaming algorithms team is looking for research partners (early-stage PhD students and their advisors) to evolve our systems so that we can support more concurrent live streams with even better quality. 

If you are an early-stage PhD student who is looking for interesting research problems that have real-world impact, read on to learn more! 

Who We Are

The streaming algorithms team is responsible for the quality of Netflix playback across Live and VoD. We design adaptive streaming algorithms in Netflix players and optimize system performance across different components on the streaming path. This team influences ⅓ of the Internet traffic, shapes the Netflix playback experience, and brings studio-quality audio to Stranger Things. Our current focus is on making our Live streaming system more scalable, with improved quality and lower latency. For this particular internship, we are seeking an early-stage PhD student with a background in computer networking who is motivated to learn more about Live streaming technologies and is interested in interdisciplinary research that combines streaming technologies, computer networking, and Encoding Technologies. 

We obsess over great playback experiences. We want playback to start immediately, at great quality, and we never want playback to stop unexpectedly. 

To provide the best possible streaming experience, we design algorithms that adapt audio and video qualities to ever-changing network conditions, encoding profiles, UI features, and device capabilities. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds, has a balanced gender ratio, and has a wide range of expertise in computer networking, video streaming, data analysis, embedded systems, and software engineering. 

Beyond the subscription-based video-on-demand service, we help Netflix expand into Live Streaming and Advertisements. We work highly cross-functionally and jointly develop our algorithms with Netflix CDN, Encoding Technologies, Data Science & Engineering, Consumer Insights, and UI Engineering. 

 

Who You Are

We are seeking an early-stage PhD student (preferably with their advisor’s involvement as well) to assist us in further enhancing the scalability of our Live streaming system and the streaming quality of experience (QoE) on millions of Netflix devices. You will also have the opportunity to help evolve the system architecture across the entire streaming path and conduct controlled field experiments to validate improvements.

More about you:

Currently an early-stage PhD student - 

 An early-stage student is defined as a student who is still looking for their thesis topics. We can also accept later-stage PhD students if their thesis is closely aligned with the topic of Live QoE and scalability. 

Experience with research projects in one of the following research areas: network measurement, algorithms related to network performance (e.g., congestion control, adaptive streaming), content delivery, or encoding technology.

Exhibit a bias to action, avoid analysis paralysis, and are willing to take smart risks

Experience with applying statistics and experimentation in research projects is a big plus. 

Experience with video is a big plus

 

Duration

40 hours per week for a 12-week period between May and September, with the possibility of extending into a longer-term research collaboration.

The Netflix Series Animation Contract Management team sits within the UCAN Business Affairs team and is responsible for ensuring that Above-The-Line (ATL) talent on our are paid correctly and on-time, as well as tracking a variety of important option dates and deadlines. 

The Role:

This is a highly cross-functional role, and the successful candidate must have the ability to work effectively and collaborate with the Business Affairs, Production Finance, Payroll, Labor, Tax, Production, Post Production and Creative teams. This person will also act as a strategic thought partner to those cross-functional teams across innovative deal structures. The Contract Management Coordinator will have extremely strong organizational skills and a high level of attention to detail, as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills. The successful candidate will exemplify the core Netflix Values, be adaptable to change, and be able to juggle multiple responsibilities at the same time. This person will need to be self-motivated and must have the ability to work proactively, independently, and reliably under tight time-frames in a fast-paced environment. 

In This Role You Will:

​Proactively review, evaluate and execute the contractual ​financial ​obligations of agreements and deal terms for ATL talent working on our series, both domestically and internationally. Our team handles payments for rights, scripts, writers, producers, consultants, casting and voice directors, production companies and more. The payments we handle can cover projects from development through launch of the series.

Prepare one-time payment authorizations and recurring payment schedules for ATL talent to facilitate timely and accurate payments. Payments are processed internally via accounts payable or payroll. Our team provides guidance for applicable guild minimums, as well as guild PH&W rates and caps. In addition, you should be familiar with loan out corporations, pay entities, local tax withholding obligations, etc. 

Track deadlines for ATL deals from the development phase through reversion, including subsequent seasons, talent and rights option deadlines and hold periods. We draft and issue relevant notices, including extensions, and option exercise notices. We track writers' room engagements, various development and production milestone deliveries, and order-to-series deadlines. 

Collect ATL payroll start paperwork, and ensure that it is accurate and complete. 

Serve as one of the points of contact for onboarding and offboarding above-the-line talent within Netflix Series Animation to ensure an excellent experience for our talent. 

Act as an internal and external ​point-of-contact​ for payment and deadline related questions.

Create and maintain filing for payments and back-up within a cloud-based document management system, and enter financial information into a shared deal/contract database. 

Periodically prepare payments and deadline tracking reports for various cross-functional teams for special ad-hoc projects.

Maintain flexibility and openness to take on additional projects as necessary, even outside of your area of expertise.

About You: 

You have 3-5 years of experience in contracts and payments administration, legal and/or business affairs at a television studio, production company, or law firm, or experience in production payroll and/or production finance.

You are familiar with union labor agreements (WGA, Local 839, Local 399, etc.). 

You have experience creating and maintaining​ WGA tracking spreadsheets and liaising with writers’ room support staff, as well as Netflix Creative and Business Affairs, for episodic script reporting and to ensure timely payments.

You are familiar with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Mail)

You are a collaborative teammate and you are willing to assist your colleagues when necessary.
