Our Team

Netflix’s Content & Business Products (CBP) department builds and buys technology that helps create, plan, produce, promote, and distribute the content our subscribers enjoy on the Netflix streaming service. We partner with cross-functional teams to develop cutting-edge solutions that are revolutionizing the entertainment industry.

The Product Directors & Managers in CBP need to (1) plan, prioritize, and execute across multiple product domains; (2) align with multiple sets of business stakeholders; and (3) connect their work to the broader product organization. To support these three altitudes of work, the CBP Operations team provides tactical support to relieve operational overhead. 

CBP Programs & Ops strives for consistency via comprehensive support to our product domain leaders and product managers. Our mission is to enhance operational efficiency by centralizing and managing essential resources, fostering effective communication, and exploring innovative technology solutions. To achieve our mission we develop operating models tailored to the product domains we support, helping to provide them with tools and insights needed for our dynamic environment – this foundational work helps us build towards a cohesive operating model for the CBP department. 

The Role

Each Program Manager of Operations is responsible for establishing a structured framework and applying operational rigor to each product domain/subdomain they’re assigned to. As a highly organized and execution-driven contributor, you will partner with cross-functional leaders (from Product, Design, Engineering/TPMs, Data Science & Engineering, etc.) to implement & improve annual planning, quarterly planning, OKR & project tracking, communication, and collaboration. When needed you will serve as an end-to-end Program Manager for high-priority initiatives that require dedicated support.

This job description outlines the initial focus areas for the role, but given the dynamic nature of Netflix and our work, the full scope of the role may evolve as needs from CBP leadership change. As operating models become more established in domains/subdomains, CBP Operations maintains structures that work well within each domain and takes on tactical support for large strategic initiatives.

Who You Are & What You’ll Be Doing

You are an observer & a doer. You exhibit a strong sense of responsibility and take pride in ownership of driving successful operational practices.

You are flexible. You thrive in a dynamic environment and can work with a high degree of autonomy. You will encounter instances in which the next steps are unclear, but you’ll have stunning colleagues to collaborate with and help uncover the best path to take.

You are tech forward. We’re experiencing a major change in the workplace with the adoption of AI-powered tools and workflows. You will be expected to contribute to this journey by expressing curiosity, leaning in, and experimenting with new ways to connect our data and work using this new tech.

You are a liaison & a great communicator. You strive to increase visibility and be a resource for ‘source of truth’ information, to reduce the cognitive load for your product teams. You involve the right people at the right times.

You are passionate about improving operations. Our CBP Operations team is a strategic execution partner in creating and maintaining operating models that enable our product teams to be more efficient and focused on business goals.

It is preferred that this role is local to either our Los Angeles or Los Gatos offices in California; our team currently uses a hybrid model where light travel between our California offices will be expected (approximately once a month). Additional travel may be required to other Netflix offices outside of the US depending on the plans and needs of the domain(s) you support.

Key Responsibilities

Our goal as a team is to create structure for CBP domains & their subdomains to operate with more rigor, to amplify their successes, and to alleviate operational work. To achieve this, each CBP Operations Program Manager will:

Aid Product Directors & Managers with tactical programming related to department & domain-level work:

Help organize & support annual planning (e.g. create and/or maintain processes, socialize templates, ensure target deadlines are being met) so they can focus on brainstorming, discovery, measurement, and resource allocation.

Aid with programming for on/offsites.

Provide tactical support to track objectives (business goals) inclusive of initiatives and projects. You will manage the tracking of OKRs, helping teams drive progress by ensuring objectives are top of mind; this information will be used for consistent QBR reporting and leadership check-ins.

Centralize information and increase visibility for product teams and stakeholders. 

Maintain documentation and systems used by the product team(s); we’ll first focus on the global aspects of annual planning, ensuring OKRs ladder up to that process, then follow by assisting with quarterly planning.

Socialize CBP work via newsletters & appropriate forums.

Use AI tools to improve workflows and efficiency. Support change management by helping teams adopt and effectively use these new tools.

Work closely with counterpart teams such as CBP Engineering Technical Program Management and CBP administrative assistants. Positive partnerships with these teams is essential for the collective success of the department. We collaborate with them by sharing important information, co-authoring documentation, co-programming events, and building & maintaining systems for visibility and tracking purposes.

Preferred Experience/Skills

4+ years of applicable program management experience in a Product organization.

Proven track record of improving operating models that stretch across multiple business functions.

Communication skills to clearly articulate and evangelize concepts across a wide organization.

Interest in and aptitude for learning new technology, specifically AI-powered tools and workflows.

Comfort using a variety of project management and product development tools.

Experience in stakeholder relationship management.

The Team

The Product Merchandising organization connects members to our world of entertainment by creating a Netflix experience that is engaging, relevant and truly delightful for everyone, everywhere. Blending intuitive discovery and local expertise, the team positions, promotes and presents content so members find it easy and enjoyable to choose what they’ll love. 

Within this organization, the New Content Exploration (NCE) team of Product Managers is leading the strategy to shape how Netflix members discover and engage with emerging content. This includes areas like games discovery, live streaming events, podcasts and much more. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes features and experiences across discovery/browse, player, profiles, and new surfaces. 

The Role

As Product Manager - Podcasts & New Content Exploration, you will drive the evolution of discovery and engagement experiences for Podcasts and other emerging content types as Netflix's offering grows. You will play a key role, partnering with the cross-functional teams, to set the vision and conceive of discovery experiences, features and capabilities that delight members. You’ll define and convert those concepts into a well-scoped project roadmaps, prioritize smartly among competing efforts, and ensure the team executes at a high level. 

As Netflix expands beyond traditional film and series, you’ll partner across the PM community to ensure the vision and strategy of the member experience for podcasts and more fit seamlessly into the bigger picture (Live, Games, and more…) 

You will sit at the intersection of Product, Tech, Content and Production, serving as the "connective tissue" that ensures our product surface evolves in lockstep with our content strategy. Your mission is to define the product strategy, audience/member needs, roadmap, and experimentation approach that allow diverse content types to flexibly thrive on a single, unified platform. You will bring an exceptional approach to partnership, exhibit deep curiosity and foster a collaborative approach when translating Podcast & New Content Exploration goals into product strategy. 

You must be comfortable at the hub of a fast-paced environment where you interface daily with cross-functional experts across both the tech and entertainment sides of the business, with proven success in how to balance requirements/tradeoffs effectively. You must be passionate about building alignment, while not being afraid to push ahead when there remain some critics, influencing and keeping momentum in the face of ambiguity. 

What You’ll Do

As Product Manager - Podcasts & New Content Exploration, you’ll be the driving force behind the product strategy for Podcasts and other emerging content types on Netflix: 

Working through open-ended problems and identifying opportunities for evolution of existing or conceptualizing new discovery, capability or feature requirements 

Build a roadmap and take product concepts from idea through validation, shipping, measurement, and iteration

Author strategy memos and presentations to represent your team’s work. Ensure the broader organization understands the Podcast/NCE product strategy and roadmap, fostering transparency 

Proactively seek diverse viewpoints to keep our focus on the most critical, strategic and impactful work in the Podcast/NCE space

Influence a team of stunning colleagues across design, engineering, consumer insights, merchandising and data science to deliver outstanding products 

Build business cases and measure the impact of your product innovation, with your data science partners

Deeply understand and socialize the evolving needs of our members, with your consumer insights and design partners

What You’ll Bring

 As Product Manager - Podcasts & New Content Exploration, you’ll be passionate about the work, bringing:

7+ years of experience developing consumer products and features and comfortable operating with complex tradeoffs

Experience working on podcast streaming products at scale, and a great understanding of the podcast lifecycle 

Ability to function as the E2E owner of the product development life cycle from inception through planning to launch

Demonstrated leadership of a space, working effectively across organizations to drive alignment

Experience with A/B testing, and strong business acumen with proficiency in identifying, tracking and acting upon metrics, designing tests, and collaborating with data science partners

Very high attention to detail, with an ability to connect the smallest experience elements to the big picture goals at the company and team level

Excellent data-informed judgment, and ability to leverage data in service of telling the right story, not the other way around

Great balance of being collaborative and open to alternative views while being decisive and clearly communicating vision

An eagerness to seek feedback and improve 

What We Offer

Meaningful Impact: Enjoy the opportunity to make a significant difference in our business, when it matters most - as we launch big bets that shape our future.

Responsibility & Autonomy: We believe in transparency and empower our employees with the autonomy to innovate. Our unique Netflix culture is a cornerstone of how we drive innovation.

Creative Freedom: Experience the freedom to tackle interesting challenges and influence outcomes in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 

Collaborative Excellence: Work alongside intelligent, driven individuals who are passionate about solving complex problems together and fostering accountability of high performance.

The Product Merchandising organization embraces flexibility in location of work with some employees working in a hybrid in-office model out of our Los Angeles or Los Gatos offices and some working remotely across the US. Please note that travel to the CA offices will be required for remote team members for key meetings as needed and occasional leadership and/or team gatherings. Lead Merchandisers are responsible for the scaled strategic guidance of title promotions for all new content types on Netflix (inclusive of Podcast, Sports (highlights and recaps), Vertical Video and more). You will be an expert in the various Merchandising surfaces and tactics, including their impact to title/slate performance and member experience as well as existing merchandising Playbooks, acting as a point of escalation for local title merchandisers and regional leaders where that expertise is required. You will use this knowledge to help deliver best-in-class presentations for a variety of title types, ensuring experiences on Netflix match their business motivation and member needs. Regionally, you implement the processes to enable this (title reviews, quarterly merch planning, prioritization of regional requests). Where playbooks do not yet exist, or have gaps, you will leverage your own knowledge and your partnership with the global functional team to define solutions. You will also provide the context and feedback back to ensure playbooks evolve as necessary. Importantly, you understand dashboards and analytics, informing and evaluating your own decision-making. You are a point of escalation for all merchandising overrides or exceptions in the region, a responsibility you exercise with global perspective and in partnership with lead merchandisers of other regions. 

You should be comfortable at the hub of a fast-paced environment where you interface daily with cross-functional experts, and can speak comfortably in both technical and creative languages. Strong merchandising background and data acumen are required. Strategic systems-thinking and creative sensibilities are key attributes of this role. A love of entertainment is a plus. 
 

You are expected to:

Ensure title merchandising in the region abides by existing principles and guidelines at scale. Existing playbooks should cover 80% of launching use cases so that title merchandisers can operate autonomously and efficiently. Escalation for your input should be required <20% of the time; your job includes identifying where new playbooks are necessary to facilitate this ratio. 

In the absence of playbooks (or grey area), this role provides guidance in consultation with the global core team. As the decision rests with this role, so too does the accountability for all non-standard title merchandising decisions. 

Be accountable for ensuring our top projects launch as expected (without issues). Your involvement should be proportional to the priority and complexity of a project (focused on a small number). 

“Quarterbacking” the merchandising effort for titles with numerous and/or new merchandising tactics applied; leading title reviews, ensuring strategies, rationales and outcomes are well-documented for senior executive visibility, etc. 

Act as point person for all algo override requests from content partners, and are accountable for articulating if/why we need an algo override, elevating recommendation for regional leader sign-off, and ensuring the impact of that override is properly captured and communicated

Understand Title Merchandising dashboards and metrics; act as point of escalation and expertise for title performance questions from partners (content, marcomms, CSA, policy, etc) as necessary.

Be an expert in product behavior; support local merchandising leadership as a point of escalation for general product knowledge, fielding Product ‘102’ questions including how innovation works, or general product behavior from local region partners.

Marry product promotional knowledge with local insights to identify where local member behaviors may diverge, and surface those to the functional team with sizing and prioritization (i.e. what is the difference, how big is it, why does it matter to members or to our business). 

Filter and prioritize all regional requests for additional merchandising support (title, catalog, messaging), and liasoning with core functional teams on approved requests. 

Being the expert in product promotional understanding, metrics and insights for titles in your region; Analyze and represent local title promotion holistically (how assets, setup, and product behavior result in end visibility), and how that impacts content performance. 

Share feedback and context on how to evolve a title’s promotional story to land better with local partners. 

You will not

Create new title merchandising playbooks or guidelines (this responsibility lies with the functional team)

Greenlight or execute partner ideas for merchandising independently (this responsibility lies with global core teams)

Be the single point of Product contact for regional partners (Content, Marketing, PR, etc). Regional Leaders are responsible for the overall function of Product Merch in a region and should manage discussions related to organizational health, overall partnership, and team performance. Launch managers and other title-level representatives will have direct relationships with partners to represent their work. Lead Merchandisers are the informed representative and experts for escalated promotional performance questions, and exceptions or clarifications for merchandising playbooks and guidelines. 

Drive asset quality strategy (i.e. what makes a good video or static asset for this vertical). 

Qualifications

6+ years of experience in Promotional Strategy, Promotional Analytics, Merchandising Roles, Product Management, or Entertainment Marketing 

Strong analytical skills; ability to read and digest quantitative insights, and craft narratives and thoughtful questions from multiple data points.

Excellent written (memos and presentations) and verbal communication skills; timely communication and ability to context-switch communication style for different audiences (i.e. content partners vs product partners)

Ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders of various backgrounds

Deep understanding of consumer behaviors and discovery habits with entertainment, understands how those intersect with content catalog and services. 

Strategic thinker with a strong customer-focused mindset and empathy

Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and drive alignment amid ambiguity

Strong curiosity to learn new domains, keep up with industry innovation, and deepen understanding 

Bachelor's degree required

We are seeking a Senior Game Engineer who is passionate about the next frontier of interactive storytelling and player agency. In this role, you won’t just be building models; you’ll be building experiences. You will leverage Generative AI to break traditional scripted boundaries, creating dynamic gameplay systems that respond to players in ways previously thought impossible.

Key Responsibilities

Design-Led Engineering: Work elbow-to-elbow with Game Designers to prototype and ship AI-augmented gameplay.

Player-Centric AI: Implement GenAI features that directly enhance the player experience, ensuring that AI-generated content feels intentional, high-quality, and most importantly, fun.

Core Systems Integration: Architect how GenAI hooks into core game systems (AI behavior trees, narrative engines, and world-building tools) to ensure seamless, low-latency performance.

Guardrails & UX: Develop the "logic layer" that sits between raw AI outputs and the player, ensuring content remains on-theme, safe, and balanced within the game's mechanics.

Applied GenAI Skills: Proven experience using LLMs or Diffusion models to solve specific product problems. You know how to prompt, fine-tune, and chain models to get predictable results in an unpredictable game world.

Systems Thinker: You understand how a change in an AI's "personality" or "generation parameters" affects game balance and the overall player journey.

Technical Proficiency: Expert-level C++ or C# (Unity/Unreal) and a grasp of Python for tooling and data pipelines.

Passion for Innovation: You are excited by "impossible" design challenges and believe GenAI is the key to unlocking new genres of play.

Cultural Stewardship:

Maintenance Programs:

The Role

We’re seeking a Creative Evaluation Lead, Artwork with hands-on experience in artwork creation and a strong grasp of how AI is reshaping the image landscape to lead strategic initiatives that will transform our promotional artwork workflows. In this role, you will bridge creative, product, and technical teams to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable solutions—redefining how we create promotional artwork at scale to support our rapidly expanding content catalog.

This role truly blends art and science. It is critical to making AI production‑ready at Netflix—linking real creative production pain points, R&D, model evaluation, learning loops, and documentation into a cohesive system that helps teams reliably and confidently adopt AI‑first creative production.

Responsibilities include:

Contribute to AI R&D and experimentation - Support R&D sprints on new AI models and evaluation methods by designing creative rubrics and defining standardized asset-level pass/fail criteria, using gold-standard creative references to enable scale annotation and QC.

Evaluate and improve AI model outputs - Oversee annotators in QCing model outputs, driving alignment on creative standards, and synthesizing findings into clear creative decisions for model improvements.

Leverage AI solutions on content launches - Execute AI solutions within active fulfillment workflows to create promotional assets for content launches, ensuring reliability, quality, and scalability.

Build and maintain a creative learning loop - Establish feedback loops by identifying patterns in human intervention during live asset fulfillment to inform model improvement opportunities.

Translate creative needs into AI opportunities - Partner with creative fulfillment teams to turn real creative production pain points into potential AI opportunities, collaborating with Product Managers to shape them into product concepts and requirements.

Lead training and maintain living documentation - Responsible for annotator and end user training. Own up-to-date training documentation on all AI model capabilities to enable effective, scalable AI use across the organization.

Stay ahead of the AI landscape - Track external developments in AI for imagery and adjacent AI fields, synthesize relevant trends, and recommend how they should inform our workflows and long-term strategy.

What We’re Looking For:

If you thrive at the intersection of AI technology and entertainment, and are excited to shape the future of promotional asset development through innovation while rolling up your creative sleeves, we’d love to hear from you! 

Qualifications:

7+ years of hands-on professional creative making experience with a focus on artwork, ideally in product, marketing, entertainment, gaming, or related fields.

Strong portfolio of video creative demonstrating craft (composition, color, typography, etc) and ability to work with brand or creative constraints.

Familiarity with AI image and/or video tools (e.g., Runway, Midjourney, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, Firefly, Leonardo) and how they’re used in creative workflows.

Experience creating or contributing to artwork style guides and templates (key art, social, title treatments, etc).

Experience with QC processes for artwork assets (creative quality, brand consistency, technical checks)

Skills and Competencies:

Blending Art and Science - Understands how strong artwork assets are made and can also translate quantitative findings into clear creative diagnoses. 

Strong Communication - Able to articulate why a creative asset works or doesn’t, and explain it clearly in a way that resonates with both creative and technical stakeholders.

Cross-Discipline Collaboration - Comfortable working closely with Product Management, Operations, Creative, and Data Science and Engineering teams.

Systems Mindset - Interest in improving models and workflows, not just individual artwork assets. A passion for scaling creative production.

Hands-on Mentality - Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do what’s needed to move work forward.

Agility and Adaptability - Comfortable working in fast-paced, iterative, data-driven environments with evolving tools and incomplete information. 

Detail-Oriented - Sharp eye for inconsistencies, errors, and off-brand elements.

The Content Platform Operations & Publishing (CPOP) team sits at the intersection of AI and machine learning, the consumer experience and the Netflix Studio. We are an integral part of making the Netflix experience feel personal and relevant by developing innovative approaches to how we promote, localize, and distribute our content. Our products impact both our members and the content creators, linguists, editors and executives who make our shows and films possible.

We are seeking a Product Manager with strong understanding of machine learning and passion for AI innovation and technology to lead strategic initiatives that will transform our internal tools and content operations. 

In this role, you will:

Drive the integration of state-of-the-art AI and machine learning models into our content platform and publishing tools enabling hyper-personalized and contextually relevant experiences for global audiences.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop intelligent systems that automate and optimize the creation of high-quality promotional assets, supporting our rapidly expanding content catalog.

Identify and implement novel AI-driven solutions to complex challenges in content distribution, asset management, and language experiences, ensuring our platform remains at the cutting edge of entertainment technology.

Partner with researchers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate the latest advancements in AI into scalable, user-centric products that empower both Netflix members and our creative partners.

If you thrive at the intersection of AI technology and entertainment, and are excited to shape the future of content operations through innovation, we’d love to hear from you!

Discover new needs that artists, creators and content executives have, distilling their needs into product roadmaps and delivering solutions that drive real business impact.

Communicate your vision and strategy broadly throughout the organization, presenting technical and complex information to non-technical audiences.

Use exceptional analytical and ML/AI evaluation skills and a rigorous, hypothesis-driven approach to inform priorities, build business cases, and measure impact.

Ability to mobilize an entire organization toward a common goal and build strong relationships across functions and geographies.

Previous experience in leading end-to-end products that incorporate Machine Learning and AI focused solutions, including experience launching AI-enabled products and perfecting/customizing underlying models.

Previous experience with the ML lifecycle (data collection and labeling, model evaluation, etc.).

Applied experience using data to inform priorities and evaluate impact.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Experience building products for creative teams, internal partners, or B2B enterprise clients.

Experience with media supply chains, localization, or translation is a plus.

As Netflix continues to scale and diversify into new business domains (e.g., Ads, Commerce, Messaging, Games), the need for a unified, robust, and developer-friendly Member Platform has never been greater. This Platform is our strategic initiative to deliver a seamless, scalable, and innovative experience for all member-facing business domains.

The Domain Experience Systems team sits at the heart of this initiative. This team builds and operates the systems that integrate advanced capabilities (e.g., Ads, Commerce, Messaging, Search, Merch, experimentation) into the Member Platform through shared APIs, arbitration and composition layers, and cross-domain workflows. Domain Experience Systems is responsible for experience Construction, API Platform, experience configurations, and related systems that bridge domains and the Member Experience in a cohesive, scalable way.

As the Senior Manager for Domain Experience Systems, you will lead a highly cross-functional, platform-focused organization that enables new and existing domains to use this platform without deep coupling, while ensuring a world-class developer experience and a consistent, high-quality member experience. You will partner closely with product, Ads, Commerce, Messaging, Search, Merch, S&D teams, and other platform teams (Page Platform, Entity Platform, Platform Scale) to make the Member Platform the “paved path” for all domains.

What we’ll expect from you:

You build and scale multiple high-performing engineering teams, hiring, inspiring, and supporting the growth of managers and senior engineers with clarity of purpose and a strong focus on inclusion and belonging.

You articulate and drive a cohesive technical and product vision for a platform experience.

You are excited to translate the needs of diverse partners (Ads, Commerce, Messaging, Merch, Search, Content, Product, Design, Marketing) into measurable platform capabilities, self-service tools, and clearly defined integration patterns.

You understand how to design, build, and operate high-traffic, low-latency distributed systems and APIs that sit directly on the critical path of the member experience, and you know how to evolve them while maintaining high availability, resiliency, and performance.

You have deep experience defining and scaling API platforms and shared abstractions, including contract design, schema evolution, governance, and tooling that enable teams to move quickly while staying aligned to platform standards.

You are comfortable balancing platform consistency with users autonomy, designing extensible architectures and clean boundaries so platform users can innovate independently while benefiting from shared infrastructure and patterns.

You forge strong cross-functional and cross-org relationships, seeking to understand business and partner needs and delighting in enabling their success through clear paved paths, documentation, and reliable platform capabilities.

You lead with data-informed judgment, collaborating with ML, experimentation/AB testing, and analytics partners to measure impact, guide tradeoffs, and improve both developer and member experiences.

You collaboratively develop and iterate on multi-year technical roadmaps, manage expectations across many stakeholders, and selflessly navigate competing priorities, making transparent tradeoffs across domains and platform needs.

You are a proactive, effective communicator, comfortable influencing at senior levels across engineering, product, and business leadership, and aligning multiple teams around strategic bets and clear outcomes.

You have experience managing other engineering managers and/or multiple teams, and are adept at building operating models, rituals, and culture that support alignment, autonomy, and accountability at scale.

You have domain experience with some of the following:

Large-scale API platforms and service-oriented or microservice architectures

Personalization, ranking, or recommendations systems

AB testing / experimentation platforms and integrating experimentation into product and platform decisions

Machine learning systems in production and their impact on client and platform design

Cloud computing and large-scale distributed systems (e.g., on AWS, GCP, or similar)

JVM-based server stacks (e.g., Java, Kotlin) or equivalent large-scale backend technologies

You have a BS or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field.

You are highly aligned with our Values.

What to expect from Netflix:

Meaningful work: your teams directly enable and accelerate Netflix’s ability to innovate globally across Ads, Commerce, Messaging, Search, Merch, and future domains through a unified platform.

Impact: you will help shape the future of how Netflix builds and evolves its member experience platform, influencing both technical direction and how new businesses integrate into the product.

Freedom & responsibility: our roles are not circumscribed, so you will have the freedom to use your judgment to make Netflix better without waiting for permission, while owning the outcomes of those decisions.

Stunning colleagues: work with amazing platform, product, ML, and application engineering talent on every project, including peers leading Page Platform, Entity Platform, Platform Scale, and Technical Leadership.

Inclusive environment: we embrace different backgrounds, perspectives, and styles because it helps us make better decisions and build better systems that work for a global, diverse membership.

Growth: learn from other selfless leaders around you, mentor other managers and senior engineers, and grow your impact by driving strategy across multiple teams and domains.

Rigor: our decisions are informed by a mix of good judgment and data. You will be expected to bring structure, clarity, and evidence to how we evolve the Member Platform, measure platform success, and prioritize investments.

We are looking for a Senior Researcher, Cultural Trends & Intelligence, to help decode the shifting cultural landscape and understand how macro and micro trends influence entertainment behaviors. In this role, you will focus on building comprehensive and innovative cultural trends research, triangulating data from multiple sources to tell the story of where culture is headed and what it means for Netflix. You will explore the zeitgeist, emerging behaviors, and the semiotics of culture to inform Brand Marketing and Product strategies. 

What You Will Do: 

Focus on cultural foresight and identifying, tracking, and analyzing cultural shifts, emerging trends, and behaviors in key markets, in partnership with Data Science & Engineering teams. 

Leverage advanced social listening tools and methodologies to analyze digital conversations, sentiment, and meme culture.

Build strong relationships and collaborations with cross-functional partners and other Consumer Insights groups to ensure that our research meets the business’s needs and empowers the decisions we make for tomorrow.

Connect the dots across complex areas and identify new opportunities to proactively inform stakeholders’ strategy. Synthesize complex data from disparate sources into compelling narratives, lead socialization, turn insights into actionable recommendations, and refine cultural fluency through the socialization process.

Work with regional insights teams to contextualize global trends with local nuances, ensuring our view of culture is inclusive and world-class.

Innovate and introduce emerging technologies or methodologies to enhance our existing work. 

About You: 

7+ years of experience in consumer insights, trend forecasting, cultural strategy, intelligence analysis, or a related field. Experience working with marketing and/or brand and/or advertising and/or Product Innovation teams is a plus.

An advanced degree in psychology, anthropology, marketing, social sciences, media studies, or related fields is preferred but not required. 

Comfortable in fast-paced environments with dynamic and shifting priorities and equipped with an entrepreneurial spirit. 

A balance of creative and analytical skills with the ability to operate proactively, define research questions, identify appropriate methods, execute studies, and synthesize findings with great storytelling.

Mixed methods research expert, including experience leading end-to-end quantitative (surveys, secondary data analysis, trend sizing) and qualitative research studies (digital ethnography, semiotics, focus groups, expert interviews). Experience with social listening platforms (such as Brandwatch, Sprinklr, etc) is essential. Experience leveraging GenAI tools for research, particularly for advanced analysis, is desirable. 

Obsessed with the zeitgeist and the forces shaping today’s culture. 

Strong communicator, with a bias toward action, who can partner efficiently with multiple teams across the company.

Experience designing and conducting global or multi‑market research in partnership with regional teams is preferred. Experience working internationally is a plus.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end production and program management – from early feasibility and budgeting, through pre‑production and shoots, to post‑production and final delivery of all campaign assets.

This is an exciting new role at the forefront of a major Netflix initiative, with significant opportunity to help shape how we produce advertiser-facing creative and to grow as we bring new offerings to market.

Core Responsibilities
CREATIVE PLANNING

Collaborate with the Brand Partnerships function to understand the types, scale, and viability of briefs or potential activations coming through the sales pipeline

Determine appropriate production approach (in-house vs. external; full-service production companies vs. specialist vendors) taking into consideration resources, budget, and lead times

Develop a project plan that drives timeline, budget, and key cross-functional stakeholder milestones, including showrunners/filmmakers 

Work closely with Netflix Marketing & Ads Legal/BA to review creative concepts, contracts, talent agreements, and other legal documents 

CAMPAIGN PRODUCTION / IMPLEMENTATION

Collaborate closely with the Strategy, Creative, Title Management, and Partner Leads for flawless and impactful campaign execution; including executional oversight and coordination of all campaign elements (e.g., video, print/ooh, talent/legal, influencer kits, digital, social media/content, activations/events, PR, etc.) 

Own and manage budgets, including reviewing and negotiating production bids and talent fees (including Netflix investment, as applicable)

Serve as the day-to-day production lead from pre-production to delivery of final campaign assets; ensuring all necessary assets are reviewed, approved, and delivered on-time to all necessary internal cross-functional partners, external talent/creator stakeholders, and Advertisers

Anticipate bottlenecks and propose solutions in advance; lead problem-solving when elements of a campaign go off-course during execution, enabling optimal outcomes so we can continue to deliver without compromising overall creative vision 

Act as the co-lead alongside the creative team in any bespoke AV productions/shoots to ensure the smooth running of the production, taking into account all requirements for the Advertiser and Netflix 

As applicable, coordinate with key internal Netflix teams for optimal amplification of the program and seamless integration around existing title marketing campaigns 

What You Bring

Minimum 7-10+ years of proven experience in commercial production, preferably in a creative agency, production company, or in-house brand studio producing multi-channel campaigns.

Proven track record producing AV commercials, branded content, social/digital content, and integrated campaigns with multiple stakeholders and complex approvals.

Strong expertise in scoping, budgeting, bidding, vendor selection, and production management across different production models.

Deep knowledge of Directors, Production Companies and Vendors who can bring creative concepts to life.

Experience working directly with Brands, Agencies, Directors, and Production Companies, with the ability to speak the language of both creatives and producers.

Prior experience in client-facing management is a must.

Ability to cultivate relationships and efficiently communicate across multiple cross-functional partners - internal, external and agency partners.

Strong attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

A personal passion for entertainment and storytelling, and excitement about redefining how brands can connect with Netflix IP, fandoms, and the Netflix brand.

Can flourish in our unique company culture.

The Production Finance Operations & Innovation (O&I) team is seeking a Data Analyst to support the Production Finance team and cross-functional partners on various data projects. The role frequently involves quick-turnaround ad hoc reports, as well as long-term analyses, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management.

This position demands the ability to succeed in a highly collaborative, fast-paced setting, a passion for data work, and the ability to learn quickly. 

Responsibilities:

Data Extraction & Transformation: Extract, clean, and transform data from core systems, including the Global Spend Report data model, Payroll Accounting Systems, and the Netflix Production Finance HUB. Aggregate and correlate data to accurately report on job counts, vendor spend, and location spend across global markets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders, including Production Finance, Public Relations & Government Relations, Finance & Strategy, Data Science & Engineering, and Studio Tech Solutions. Act as a proactive thought partner, translating complex business needs into actionable data solutions.

Ad Hoc & Strategic Analysis: Engage in both rapid-turnaround ad hoc analyses (e.g., show-level spend, vendor breakdowns, cast and crew location analytics) and longer-term strategic projects (e.g., trend analysis, workflow optimization). Provide actionable insights and clear reporting to support decision-making.

Technical Development & Workflow Improvement: Develop expertise in the existing data models, identify data inconsistencies, and recommend improvements to data collection and validation processes. Explore and utilize data tables owned by adjacent business partners to enhance data coverage and integration.

Data Visualization & Reporting: Analyze structured datasets to develop metrics, dashboards, and trend reports using data visualization tools such as Google Sheets, Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms. Present insights in a clear, accessible manner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

System & Tool Experimentation: Proactively engage in self-training and experimentation with new tools and technologies to improve analytics workflows and drive innovation.

Production Finance Team Support: Guide Production Finance executives on data access, analysis, and reporting. Respond to requests for data pulls, insights, and custom analyses as needed.

Data Quality & Issue Resolution: Monitor data integrity and troubleshoot urgent issues affecting data coverage or quality, ensuring the highest standards of accuracy and completeness.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Maintain clear documentation of data processes, workflows, and system configurations. Share best practices and learnings with the broader team to foster continuous improvement.

Education & Experience:

A degree in a quantitative field (e.g., mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or similar)

5+ years of experience in data science, analytics engineering, or a similar data field.

Experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, or other Entertainment Industry areas preferred

Ability to collaborate with various teams and stakeholders, work with business end-users to understand data and analysis needs.

Skills & Abilities:

Advanced SQL proficiency and database infrastructure knowledge required

Advanced G Sheets proficiency required

Experience with Python/R or other statistical programming languages is required

Excellent data analysis and visualization skills

Familiarity with Business Intelligence tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms

Working knowledge of database concepts and data pipelines

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with key stakeholders

Ability to communicate effectively with global teams

Ability to show flexibility in re-prioritizing as situations arise throughout the day

Detail-oriented but also interested in understanding the bigger picture

Must thrive in a fast-paced and collaborative team environment

Flexible and open to different perspectives

We are seeking a Post Production expert to add to the UCAN (U.S. and Canada) Live Sports and Specials Post Production Team in Los Angeles. This position will work with the Netflix Post Production team in executing the day-to-day tasks involved in overseeing a slate of Live Sports and Specials titles produced by external production companies and sports producers. Post Production Managers serve as the key point of contact for both external and internal partners, tracking and organizing vital post-production information and workflows from pre-production through post-production and wrap, as well as contributing to ongoing internal projects with cross-departmental teams at Netflix.
 

The Role

A successful candidate will have extensive knowledge of post production for live broadcasts, substantial hands-on experience working in post production for live sports, as well as a strong understanding of workflows for large-scale live entertainment programming. Candidates should be self-motivated, proactive, quick-thinking, flexible, thorough, and able to juggle multiple and diverse tasks, with a strong emphasis on organization and an unwavering attention to detail. This is a demanding and fast-moving position that requires high performance, a bias for action, and a positive demeanor. Candidates should excel at exercising good judgment and communication even during times of ambiguity.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Technical Setup and Workflow Management

Collaborate with Netflix Live Technical Management, Distribution, Localization teams, and external production/post partners to define and implement key post-production workflows—including camera capture, HDR color pipelines, master delivery, and final archive—with a strong focus on 4K and multicam, live-to-tape environments.

Establish and manage workflows for internal content reviews, such as cut reviews for pre-produced packages, features, and edited SVOD content.

Evaluate, vet, and enhance partner delivery workflows for SVOD content derived from live broadcasts.

Set up and maintain delivery workflows for Netflix-produced assets entering live broadcasts, overseeing asset management from internal creative teams to production control rooms or Broadcast Operations.

Assess new technical initiatives and determine their feasibility and application on a project-by-project basis.

Budgeting & Financial Oversight

Review creative requirements to define post-production budget and strategy.

Partner with Post Supervisors and Line Producers to prepare, review, and refine show budgets and schedules, providing feedback on viability and potential risks.

Track, manage, and report all post-production costs, ensuring stakeholders are kept informed of status and changes.

Post Scheduling & Coordination

Analyze production and post production schedules to identify efficiencies and potential improvements.

Draft and inform post-production schedules as needed.

Collaborate with internal teams (Distribution, Localization) and external production partners to finalize and manage post schedules.

Communicate key cut schedule milestones and updates to all stakeholders.

Staffing & Vendor Management

Review and approve facilities for graphics, VFX, animation, color, and sound services.

Source, interview, and approve key post-production hires, including post producers, supervisors, editors, and assistant editors.

Select and manage relationships with post-production vendors to support creative vision, budget, tax incentives, and location requirements.

Maintain and curate preferred vendor and staffing lists to ensure access to top-tier talent and resources.

Content Management

Organize and participate in key creative approval sessions, such as final mix playbacks, VFX reviews, and color correction sessions.

Oversee the assessment and communication of all deliverables, ensuring timely delivery and strict technical compliance.

Qualifications:

Minimum 7 years of live post production experience as a Post Production Supervisor, or a managerial role within a post production vendor or sports media operations team.

Experience in a fast-paced environment overseeing several projects at various points of production (from development through delivery).

A passion for live content.

Experience managing quick turnaround and topical content where deadlines are firm.

Knowledge of current trends and workflows for UHD, HDR (Dolby Vision/HLG), and Dolby Atmos.

Familiar with professional-grade camera formats and post production tools used during editorial, online, grading, and sound post workflows. 

Team player who operates in a fast-paced team-oriented setting.

Flexible with schedule (with ability to work some holidays and weekends, as needed)

Ability to be discreet and maintain confidential information.

Understanding how to prioritize and respond accordingly.

Desire and self-motivation to continuously learn.

Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to multitask.

Proficiency in Google Suite and knowledge of budgeting software.

Netflix is looking for a versatile, strategic, and industrious Senior Games Title Product Manager, Portfolio to help scale how we operate and grow our games portfolio across mobile and cloud titles. The preferred location for this role is Los Angeles, though remote work will be considered, with a preference for candidates in the PST time zone who are able to travel. Travel is required for quarterly in-person onsites held at our Los Angeles or Los Gatos offices.

As a Senior Games Title Product Manager, you will play a critical role in scaling Netflix Games’ product effectiveness across a diverse slate — enabling clearer measurement, faster decision-making, and more consistent execution across four gaming verticals. This is a senior-range role designed for breadth and context switching: you will lead horizontal product work that spans all titles (and requires deep cross-functional partnership), and you will flex into priority game teams when coverage gaps or peak needs emerge.

Responsibilities

Build and run cross-portfolio product operating systems that improve speed and consistency across the slate (e.g., KPI definitions, instrumentation norms, dashboards, reads, decision forums, and performance cadences).

Partner deeply with Data Science & Engineering (DSE) to define and operationalize vertical KPI frameworks, ensure measurement quality, and create durable product performance rituals.

Partner deeply with Finance & Strategy (F&S) to establish operating cadence and the mechanisms for how Games Product plugs into planning and reporting.

Own portfolio governance frameworks including scoring, tiering, and resourcing recommendations, and help drive quarterly rebalancing aligned to impact.

Lead complex, multi-stakeholder horizontal initiatives that require PM rigor and continuity — for example, ironing out and operationalizing a UA Optimization model and related decision-making processes in partnership with F&S, DSE, and Marketing.

Champion cross-portfolio IP moments for live service, coordinating opportunities that span multiple titles rather than a single game team.

Flex into priority game teams to provide support Games Title Product Managers during launches, major updates, system rewrites, or peak complexity — driving clearly defined workstreams without changing the primary owner.

Serve as interim primary owner for titles that need Games Title PM coverage before they warrant a dedicated embedded PM, with clear exit criteria and conversion recommendations as the slate evolves.

Synthesize learnings across titles to identify what’s working, what’s not, and where we should standardize playbooks to avoid reinvention.

Requirements

10+ years of experience in product management for games or a highly related role.

Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional, multi-stakeholder programs with high ambiguity and multiple workstreams.

Strong product judgment and ability to operate at multiple altitudes: strategic frameworks + hands-on execution.

Strong data fluency with a track record of using insights to drive decisions (comfort partnering with data science, defining KPIs, and shaping measurement).

Experience building and running operating cadences (dashboards/reads/decision forums) that change how teams make decisions.

Familiarity with game performance levers across the lifecycle (e.g., onboarding, engagement loops, retention, content cadence), with live service experience preferred.

Comfort collaborating across disciplines including production, design, engineering, marketing, finance/strategy, and analytics.

Ability to context switch quickly while maintaining clarity of ownership, priorities, and outcomes.

Excellent communication skills; comfortable influencing across teams and disciplines.

Adaptability and comfort navigating ambiguity in a rapidly evolving organization.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic thinker to join our Central Operations team as a Senior Associate of Revenue Analytics & Insights. This role will focus on creating globally standardized reports and insights for our Sales, Account Management, programmatic, and Ad Ops teams to drive revenue growth and enhance decision-making. You will work closely with Product Marketing, Regional Sales Operations, Ads Data, and other cross-functional partners to develop impactful analytics, uncover trends, and recommend strategies by identifying existing best practices to standardize globally, as well as new reporting visuals and analyses to equip Regional Sales Operations to partner with their Sales teams locally.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Analysis: Delivering revenue and product analytics, focusing on key performance indicators (KPIs) to track progress against goals and identify revenue growth opportunities.

Insights & Reporting: Establish data-driven best practices for defining, tracking, and operationalizing product-, initiative-, and org-level metrics that influence sales behaviors and drive incremental revenue. Convince and influence stakeholders with clear data-backed insights and recommendations. 

Revenue Forecasting & Planning: Model and deliver Sales forecasts that provide insight to Sales, Sales Operations, and Product Teams. Conduct analyses to break down targets at the product, team, and region levels

Data Visualization & Storytelling: Build intuitive visualizations using tools like Tableau, Looker, or GSheets that convey information in a clear, compelling way to stakeholders at all levels.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Ads Data, Product Marketing, Regional Sales Operations, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to compare analyses in order to deepen understanding on product levers and revenue-driving initiatives, ultimately conveying back to Sales Operations and Sales Leadership.

Process Improvement: Identify ways to streamline reporting processes and analytics workflows to ensure efficiency and accuracy. Reduce time spent in Regional Sales Operations creating reports by centralizing and automating reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of experience in business analytics, product analytics, or other quantitative roles, ideally in a high-growth, fast-paced media/technology company.

Strong analytical skills in SQL, Python/R, and BI Tools (such as Tableau or Power BI), to provide clear insights and recommendations.

Familiarity with sales performance metrics, product success metrics, and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).

Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for non-technical audiences, with an eye for detail.

A strategic mindset with the ability to think big-picture while diving into granular details.

Demonstrated experience in navigating highly ambiguous environments and gaining cross-functional buy-ins.

Role Description

The AI Solution Analyst will be part of the Process Excellence team within the Finance Program Management Office (PMO). This role accelerates Netflix's citizen builder movement by owning key enablement activities, including developing and deploying upskilling curricula and guiding and supporting Finance teams in building solutions using enterprise AI solutions and automation tools.

This is an enablement-first role designed to drive a citizen-builder culture and help Netflix Finance users successfully leverage available tools to enhance automation and drive adoption.

This role sits within Finance and requires close collaboration with Finance stakeholders and product/engineering teams. This is a hybrid position based in Los Angeles or Los Gatos with flexibility to work remotely part of the time. Occasional travel to other offices, including internationally, may be required.

Responsibilities

Enablement & Training 

Collaborate with our existing CoE and GenAI champions to design upskilling programs and training materials to enable literacy and drive adoption in line with organizational goals 

Host training sessions tailored to meet Finance users at their current skill level — from first-time prompt writing to building agents

Provide visibility into upcoming training opportunities and proactively assess needs across the FinOps organization

Create reusable assets: Develop templates, starter kits, prompt libraries, etc. — that lower the barrier to self-serve

Host regular office hours, hackathons, and communities of practice to build a self-sustaining builder culture

Solution Design & Coaching

Partner with Finance teams to identify and prioritize automation opportunities scoped to what can be built using enterprise AI and automation solutions

Collaborate with Finance users to identify potential solution paths and work alongside the teams to implement them — coaching and collaborating through the build, transferring skills in the process, vs. building 

Support with rapid prototyping or POC development to determine feasibility before larger time and effort investments

Insights

Develop and distribute surveys to determine the effectiveness of training and upskilling opportunities

Maintain close relationships with GenAI champions to understand training needs for specific teams and develop action plans

Collaborate with Product & Technology teams to continuously improve adoption tracking and insights 

Provide PMO leadership with regular insight into automation adoption, risks, and areas of opportunity

Qualifications

Required

5+ years of hands-on experience with intelligent automation (RPA, AI agents, etc.), with recent practical experience applying GenAI and AI agents to business processes

Demonstrated ability to prototype and build solutions using enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Google Gemini)

Strong process analysis skills with working knowledge of core Finance processes (Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, FP&A)

Proven experience designing and delivering technical training or enablement programs — not just creating materials, but driving actual adoption and behavior change

Effective cross-functional collaborator who can translate between business needs and technical capabilities

Comfort working at the boundary of business and engineering without owning either domain fully

Preferred

Experience in a Finance, accounting, or FP&A environment

Familiarity with change management frameworks applied to technology adoption

THE TEAM

The Netflix Brand Creative Studio (BCS) is our in-house team of Strategists, Creatives, Designers, Producers, and Program Managers. We are the creative collective behind Netflix’s most high-profile brand initiatives, developing work that builds passionate fandoms and shapes how the world connects with our brand. Our mission is to strengthen the Netflix brand and drive business value by creating culturally relevant marketing that is as entertaining as our shows, films, games, and experiences. Our studio serves as a centralized partner for a wide range of business-critical areas—spanning Global Brand and Brand Partnerships, Ads, Consumer Products, and live experiences like Netflix House.

 

As Netflix continues to expand into new business units, formats, and physical experiences, the volume and complexity of design output across the company continues to grow. To support this scale, BCS is evolving its operating model to include a dedicated production design team focused on speed, systems, and consistency, without compromising craft.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Production Designer to join the Brand Creative Studio. This role is an individual contributor within the production design team, responsible for delivering high-quality, brand-led design output at scale across multiple business functions, including the Netflix Brand, Netflix House, Product Marketing, Consumer Products, and Corporate Communications.

This role reflects a creative agency and design studio model of production design, where designers work within established systems to execute a high volume of work efficiently and thoughtfully. You will partner closely with the Senior Manager, Production Design and cross-functional teams to bring brand strategy and design systems to life across channels, markets, and formats.

A strong portfolio demonstrating solid design fundamentals, attention to detail, and experience working within brand systems is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Production Design & Execution

Design and produce high-volume, brand-led assets across a range of outputs, including lower-funnel marketing assets, campaign toolkits, sales materials, and presentation design.
 

Execute work within established brand systems, templates, and production frameworks, ensuring consistency and quality across deliverables.
 

Apply strong design fundamentals to every output, with attention to typography, layout, hierarchy, and clarity.

Cross-Functional Creative Support

Collaborate with partners across Brand, Product Marketing, Consumer Products, Netflix House, and Corporate Comms to support a wide range of creative needs.
 

Contribute to presentation design for executive, sales, and high-priority communications where clarity and brand expression are critical.
 

Ensure work is fit-for-purpose across audiences and channels while adhering to Netflix brand standards.

Systems & Workflow Contribution

Support the ongoing development and refinement of templates, modular systems, and production workflows.
 

Adapt existing systems to new formats, channels, and use cases as needed.
 

Work efficiently within fast-moving timelines while maintaining a high standard of craft.

Craft, Quality & Growth

Uphold quality and attention to detail across all production outputs.
 

Incorporate feedback thoughtfully and iterate quickly.
 

Stay current on best practices in production design, brand systems, and design tooling.
 

QUALIFICATIONS

4–6 years of experience in design within a creative agency, design studio, or in-house brand team.
 

Strong foundation in visual design, including typography, layout, hierarchy, and composition.
 

Experience working within established brand systems and templates.
 

Ability to execute high-volume design work efficiently without sacrificing quality.
 

Exposure to a range of outputs, such as marketing assets, toolkits, sales materials, and presentation design.
 

Strong collaboration skills and comfort working with cross-functional partners.
 

Fluency in modern design tools and workflows (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite; motion experience a plus).
 

Clear communicator who is receptive to feedback and eager to learn.
 

Highly organized and comfortable working in fast-paced environments.
 

Interest in growing within a production design or systems-led design practice.

The Team

The Product Merchandising organization connects members to our world of entertainment by creating a Netflix experience that is engaging, relevant and truly delightful for everyone, everywhere. Blending intuitive discovery and local expertise, the team positions, promotes and presents content so members find it easy and enjoyable to choose what they’ll love. 

Within this organization, the New Content Exploration (NCE) team of Product Managers is leading the strategy to shape how Netflix members discover and engage with emerging content. This includes areas like games discovery, live streaming events, podcasts and much more. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes features and experiences across discovery/browse, player, profiles, and new surfaces. 

The Role

The Group Product Manager, New Content Exploration will lead a team of high-performing, principled and strategic Product Managers. As Netflix expands beyond traditional film and series, this leader is responsible for the vision and strategy of how the member product experience evolves to meet rapidly-evolving new content needs. 

You will sit at the intersection of Product, Tech and Content, serving as the "connective tissue" that ensures our product surface evolves in lockstep with our content strategy. Your mission is to define the product strategy, audience/member needs, roadmap, and experimentation approach that allows diverse content types to flexibly thrive on a single, unified platform. You will bring an exceptional approach to partnership, exhibit deep curiosity and foster a collaborative approach when translating content goals into product strategy. 

You will partner with key leaders across the company to set the vision and ideate new ways to delight members, and convert those ideas into well-scoped projects. You will prioritize competing efforts and lead the talented PM team to execute. You must be comfortable at the hub of a fast-paced environment, interfacing daily with cross-functional experts on both the tech and entertainment sides of the business, with proven success in balancing requirements and trade-offs effectively. You must be passionate about building alignment, while not being afraid to push ahead even when there are critics, leading in the face of ambiguity. 

What You’ll Do

As Group Product Manager, you’ll be the driving force behind our product strategies for new content experiences, focusing on:

Leadership & Team Development: Oversee a strong team of PMs, guiding them in setting and achieving ambitious goals. Actively coach, mentor, and grow the team, ensuring a collaborative, supportive, and high-performing environment. 

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership: Oversee the end-to-end member discovery and experience strategy for new content integration. This includes leading prioritization across your portfolio, coordinating closely across Engineering, Data & Insights, Experience Design, Content, Games and Merchandising teams.

Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional leaders to articulate a compelling product vision, turn that vision into actionable, well-scoped roadmap and prioritize thoughtfully across multiple initiatives simultaneously.

Organizational Alignment & Communication: Ensure the broader organization understands the business and product strategy and roadmap, fostering transparency. Proactively seeking diverse viewpoints to keep our focus on the most critical, strategic and impactful work.

What You’ll Bring

As Group Product Manager, you’ll set the tone for your team and be passionate about the work, bringing:

Proven Leadership: 10-12+ years in Product Management, Product Marketing and/or Product Merchandising roles. You have a demonstrated ability to develop and inspire teams to achieve ambitious outcomes. Comfort advocating for a path forward among ambiguous options. 

Strategic Thinking & Communication: You’re a strategic thinker and exceptional communicator who excels in both written and verbal forms. You can clearly convey product concepts and lead thoughtful discussions on strategic developments, decision-making, and progress with your team and with leadership. You have the ability to synthesize the complex into the simple and persuasive, telling compelling stories that balance a strong, informed and intuitive perspective with data. 

Growth Mindset & High Attention to Detail: You bring a growth mindset and a high attention to detail, understanding how every product element connects to broader team and company goals. 

Cross-Functional Expertise: You have experience working in matrixed environments where products or platforms cut across multiple teams and functions. You are collaborative and open to alternative views while being decisive and clearly communicating team vision.

Technical & Analytical Prowess: You are familiar with ML-powered consumer experiences, with strong experience in building features and A/B testing. You have excellent data-informed judgment. You are passionate about leveraging data in service of telling the right story, not the other way around. 

Experience and Familiarity with integrating content types: You have experience working on consumer facing media/entertainment or content streaming products at scale, having worked on products where different content offerings merge into one product experience.

Meaningful Impact: Enjoy the opportunity to make a significant difference in our business, when it matters most - as we launch big bets that shape our future.

Responsibility & Autonomy: We believe in transparency and empower our employees with the autonomy to innovate. Our unique Netflix culture is a cornerstone of how we drive innovation.

Creative Freedom: Experience the freedom to tackle interesting challenges and influence outcomes in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 

Collaborative Excellence: Work alongside intelligent, driven individuals who are passionate about solving complex problems together and fostering accountability of high performance.

About the Role:

This PM will be responsible for building a new foundational technology that connects systems across Netflix Ads. We are seeking a visionary to lead the development and management of our Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) infrastructure for Ads. This role enables confidential compute for sensitive, multi-party workloads (especially where Netflix and partner data must be jointly processed) while preserving privacy, integrity, and auditability.

This means building for other builders; laying the foundations for our stunning colleagues across engineering, product, data science, measurement, audience, identity, and ad serving. TEEs will work hand-in-hand with our Data Clean Room infrastructure; leveraging both to deliver privacy-preserving joins and computation with verifiable assurances.

This PM will:

Define and drive the product vision and roadmap for Ads TEE Infrastructure, making privacy-preserving compute accessible to internal teams and repeatable across partners.

Deliver a platform (APIs, SDKs, templates) that supports attested, encrypted-in-use computation for common Ads workloads without bespoke engineering for each integration.

Partner closely with Data Clean Room infrastructure to design complementary flows where data preparation and governance occur in Clean Rooms and sensitive realtime computation/inference executes in TEEs.

Collaborate with Security, Privacy, Legal, and partner technology teams to establish joint execution protocols, attestations, and evidence capture that meet contractual and regulatory requirements.

Provide first-class developer experience: job templates, declarative specs, workflow integration, observability, and clear guidance on cost-to-assurance tradeoffs and performance tuning.

Integrate with core data and compute planes (e.g., Snowflake, S3/GCS, Kafka, Spark/Flink) with robust identity, RBAC/ABAC, per-tenant isolation, and secure IO patterns.

Define and track success metrics such as number of secure jobs executed, time-to-attest, partner adoption, and evidence quality; iterate quickly based on data and feedback.

Serve as connective tissue across Ads Data Science, Measurement, Audience, Identity, Ad Serving/Decisioning, and Partner Solutions to unblock high-impact use cases.

We’re seeking a candidate who has:

Experience: 10+ years of Product Management/Engineering experience with a proven track record of launching and scaling foundational, security-critical platforms; experience in confidential computing or privacy-preserving technologies. Experience in advertising technology or data products is a strong plus, especially where handling sensitive advertiser/partner/member data is required.

Domain Awareness: Familiarity with advertising data workflows and controls across publishers, advertisers, and measurement partners. e.g., data minimization, purpose limitation, data retention policies, seeded audience joins, measurement signal handling, and contractual/usage constraints. Publisher-side experience preferred; demand-side experience also valuable.

Visionary Leadership: Ability to deliver a comprehensive roadmap and vision for TEE-backed, multi-party compute that supports diverse internal teams and external partners.

Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of TEEs and adjacent privacy tech (e.g., AWS Nitro Enclaves, GCP Confidential Computing, Azure SEV-SNP; knowledge of SGX/SEV/ARM CCA helpful), secure software supply chain (signed artifacts, SBOMs), attestation, key management, and encrypted data-in-use.

Adversarial Mindset: Familiarity with the adversarial nature of partner integrations and the controls required to mitigate misuse in advertising contexts (e.g., inference attacks, data leakage, cross-tenant contamination, reconstruction risks); strong instincts for auditability and evidence.

Domain Awareness: Knowledge of advertising-oriented data workflows; publisher-side experience preferred, demand-side experience also valuable.

Collaborative Skills: Proven experience working with cross-functional teams, including Security, Privacy, Legal, Data Science, Engineering, and external partner technology/security teams.

Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with legal compliance and the evolving landscape of data privacy and advertising regulations worldwide.

Solid understanding of U.S. and international corporate income tax.

Strong oral and written communication skills and the ability to effectively interact cross-functionally and with external advisors.

Instant streaming is a key component of Netflix's future strategy. Our first product to support instant streaming to TVs was launched in May 2008. Since then, we have continued to grow the number of Netflix-enabled devices across Smart TVs, Blu-ray players, streaming sticks, and Operator set-top boxes, now amassing thousands of unique integrations. Our partnerships encompass many of the world’s leading consumer electronics brands, including Samsung, LG, Amazon, and Roku, as well as numerous top global operators.

With millions of users streaming Netflix, device reliability is a critical focus area. We aim to delight our customers with a service that consistently works, allowing them to watch Netflix. The Device Reliability Team is responsible for post-launch monitoring and supporting our partners’ Netflix integrations on Smart TVs, Blu-ray players, general set-top boxes (e.g., Roku), and MVPD set-top boxes (e.g., satellite and cable boxes) to enhance the overall quality and reliability of our systems.
