At Netflix, delivering an unparalleled entertainment experience to millions of members worldwide relies on a robust, scalable global content delivery network—Open Connect. As a Data Center Deployment Engineer, you’ll ensure that our 100+ edge data centers are deployed, upgraded, and prepared to meet the growing demands of our expanding service, enabling seamless video streaming, cloud gaming, and live experiences. You’ll collaborate with network architects, engineers, provisioners, capacity planners, logisticians, and others, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.

In this role, you’ll manage multiple concurrent deployments while driving process improvements to ensure capacity is available ahead of demand. You’ll plan, document, and oversee complex data center builds, deployments, and upgrades. Managing global 'remote hands' vendors, you will provide detailed instructions and proactively address challenges. A key part of your role will be ensuring consistency across the team, and aligning practices to maintain high standards. You'll also enhance efficiency by sharing lessons learned and identifying opportunities for automation and simplification.

Learn more about the unique Netflix culture and the opportunity by reading up on our culture and long-term view. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Project manage the design, planning, deployment, and refreshing of network and content serving infrastructure at new and existing Open Connect data center points of presence.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external vendors to orchestrate deployments, deliver capacity, and develop project scopes while ensuring availability and performance.

Produce and maintain comprehensive documentation, including rack elevations, power consumption, cabling, run books, and handover documents, capturing all details for planned, installed, and as-built stages of deployments.

Create a bill of materials for each project, ensuring all necessary items —including structured cabling, optics, and network gear —are available on-site before rack-and-stack. Order non-stock items as needed and recommend materials for regular stocking to support efficient future deployments.

Manage remote hands vendors, providing clear scopes of work and ensuring adherence to SLAs, performance standards, and seamless execution, onboarding new vendors when necessary.

Collaborate with infrastructure, operations, and architecture teams to develop long-term solutions that enhance network infrastructure and support future growth.

Identify and drive improvements in our internally developed management tools and automation processes.

Lead complex network upgrades and migrations, ensuring coordination and clear communication throughout.

Troubleshoot and resolve networking, power, cooling, and fiber issues in data centers.

Provide mentorship and technical leadership to deployment team members and stakeholders.

Gain a comprehensive understanding of Open Connect Appliance functionality and its integration with network roadmaps.

What’s Required

Proven project management experience with a creative, problem-solving approach.

Ability to improve processes and workflows, foster collaboration, and encourage team performance through effective communication and strong interpersonal skills.

Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills to communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Flexibility to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities across a global footprint — with nearly half of our deployments in Africa, Asia, and Europe — requires collaboration across time zones and off-hour work to support global IX operations.

Meticulous attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and excellent problem-solving abilities.

Expertise in networking concepts and protocols, including routing, switching, DWDM, and fiber optics.

Layer 1 knowledge, including patch panels, fiber optic connectors, optic types, and form factors (e.g., LC, SC, MTP, CFP2, QSFP, SFP+).

Deep understanding of power standards, including kW power/heat load, voltage, amperage, and applications of single-phase, three-phase, and DC systems.

5+ years of experience in Edge Networks and Data Centers as a Deployment Engineer or similar role.

Experience configuring and troubleshooting server and network hardware—both hands-on and remotely—including installation, firmware updates, IP addressing, and other operational settings.

Contribute to the team's success by offering mentorship and technical support to peers and stakeholders, while actively seeking guidance and learning opportunities to deepen expertise and strengthen team dynamics.

Proven ability to manage and work with remote vendors globally.

Willingness to travel for quarterly off-sites/on-sites, team syncs, and occasional project site visits, including overnight stays.

How to Stand Out

Expertise in system administration, scripting, automation, and optimizing OS/Network performance.

Experience designing and prototyping structured cabling.

Experience developing remote hands vendor scorecards and metrics.

Extensive experience deploying DWDM platforms and a solid working knowledge of high-power optics and attenuation.

Experience in web-scale, cloud networking, and hybrid environments.

Budget management skills and experience with financial planning for cost-effective deployments.

The Head of Talent Experiences & Gifting(UCAN) leads the strategy and execution of Netflix’s talent experience programs across the U.S. and Canada. This role sits at the intersection of entertainment, culture, and creative storytelling, designing thoughtful moments that celebrate the artists and collaborators behind Netflix’s films and series.

From start of production through premieres, awards season, and major cultural events, the Head of Talent Experiences & Gifting shapes thoughtful experiences that deepen relationships with talent and create lasting impressions.

This role partners closely with teams across marketing, publicity, communications, policy, live events, ads, brand, and many others to identify moments where thoughtful gestures and well-timed gifting can strengthen relationships and support key moments across the business.

The UCAN Head of Talent Experiences & Gifting reports to the Global Head of Talent Experiences & Gifting and works closely with regional counterparts across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM to share ideas, scale programs globally, and evolve how Netflix celebrates its creative community.

Responsibilities

Ensure gifting initiatives align with broader business priorities and strategies, brand goals, and relationship objectives.

Identify and pursue opportunities to expand the scope and impact of the Talent Experiences & Gifting function across the business.

Evolve the current UCAN regional gifting strategy across Productions, Awards, Live Events, and B2B.

Provide strategic oversight of all creative outputs across UCAN to ensure gifting reflects Netflix’s brand identity, tone, and values.

Set the creative vision for innovative gifting and experiential initiatives that strengthen relationships with talent, collaborators, and business partners.

Apply deep knowledge of the UCAN market, including cultural nuances, logistics, and expectations around gifting and brand experiences.
Bring a strong understanding of the entertainment industry, talent experience, and studio environments.

Stay ahead of cultural, creative, and industry trends to ensure Netflix remains a leader in experiential and meaningful gifting.

Collaborate with the team’s regional leaders to drive alignment across talent experiences, gifting strategies, processes, systems, and the adoption of new tools and technology.

Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to deliver a consistently high level of service and partnership across the organization.

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Managers that values creativity, collaboration, accountability, and growth.

Foster a healthy and inclusive team culture by staying closely attuned to morale and engagement.

Provide clear direction, thoughtful feedback, and ongoing guidance to ensure consistent excellence across all workstreams.

Oversee the development of custom packaging and storytelling-led gift concepts that elevate brand perception and impact.

Partner with regional leaders to align on brand partnerships and gifting opportunities that can scale across multiple regions.

Manage agency, vendor, and warehouse relationships to ensure quality, efficiency, and cost effectiveness.

Conduct regular reviews of agency and operational workflows, costs, and fees to maintain transparency and avoid surprises.

Identify, evaluate, and onboard new partners that bring strong alignment, innovation, or added value.

Streamline workflows and processes to improve efficiency for both internal teams and external partners.

Leverage technology to enable global collaboration and support operational scalability.

Maintain clear, organized documentation across creative assets, vendor lists, and key contacts.

Passion for storytelling, brand-building, and delivering exceptional talent experiences.

The CS Technology team is part of the CS organization and is responsible for ensuring the right CS tools and technologies are in place and well-functioning to support the operations, growth, and scalability of the Customer Service business now and in the future. 

The CS Technology team is comprised of CS Product Management, Product Operations, and Technical Operations. The Technical Operations function is responsible for ensuring that CS tools and technologies are well configured and running without errors or issues, enabling secure, reliable, and scalable operations of our technology for our global CS teams. As the technical department of the Customer Service organization, Technical Operations leads the planning, coordination, and execution of all technical components of CS projects, partnering closely with CS Product and Engineering teams, CS cross-functional and stakeholder teams, and BPO IT teams.

We are looking for an experienced technical operations leader to join our team as Senior Manager, Technology Operations – CS Technology. In this role, you will lead and manage a lean, high-impact team strategically located across US and LATAM regions. 

Your success will be built on strong collaboration and partnership with stakeholders across InfoSec, Data Privacy, Legal, Internal Audit, CS Product, Engineering, and multiple CS cross-functional teams. You have a passion for supporting the Customer Service business from behind the scenes, a drive for operational excellence and continuous improvement, and a deep curiosity about understanding and anticipating stakeholder needs.

You will oversee a diverse team that includes program managers (for reliability, security, and BPO IT management), CS tool support specialists, and system administrators. In addition, you will manage key third-party solution vendor relationships related to Managed Services, Support Programs, and SLAs, including oversight of resource allocation and planning in partnership with the CS Product team.

As a strategic and hands-on leader, you will be responsible for:

Driving the operational strategy and execution for Technology Operations to support the scale and complexity of Netflix’s global CS operations.

Leading and developing a lean, globally distributed team focused on delivering high-impact results and fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Providing hands-on guidance and mentorship to team members to help them grow in skills, confidence, and experience, and to collaborate effectively with third-party partners and internal engineering teams.

Overseeing the planning and execution of support models, including the potential implementation of on-call or 24/7 support.

Building and nurturing strong cross-functional partnerships across InfoSec, Data Privacy, Legal, Internal Audit, CS Product and Engineering, and all relevant CS functions.

Collaborating with internal stakeholders and third-party vendors on Support and Managed Service aspects, ensuring alignment on priorities, resource allocation, and operational excellence.

Ensuring contracted SLAs are met and managing vendor resources effectively and independently, driving governance and performance improvements.

Rapidly establishing clear accountability and process discipline within a high-growth, dynamic environment.

Overseeing the implementation and continuous improvement of IT operations best practices, incident management, security/access management, and service delivery at scale.

Partnering closely with CS Product team and Engineering teams to ensure customer service technologies and infrastructure are reliable, secure, and well-configured.

Using data-driven insights to identify and implement opportunities for efficiency, reliability, and performance improvements, and to provide visibility to leadership on key metrics, risks, and opportunities.

Fostering a collaborative and innovative team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and professional growth.

Demonstrating stakeholder empathy and curiosity to seek understanding and proactively address business needs.

Embody the unique Netflix culture.

What we’re looking for

8+ years of experience in technical operations, IT service management, or technology support roles, with at least 3 years in a leadership capacity.

Demonstrated success in building, developing, and scaling high-performing, lean technical operations or support teams in fast-paced, global environments.

Experience mentoring and guiding multidisciplinary teams, including system administrators and application/tooling support specialists.

Proven ability to operate in high-volume customer service, contact center, or BPO environments.

Strong track record of cross-functional collaboration with internal engineering teams and third-party vendors, specifically in Support and Managed Service areas.

Vendor management experience, including driving governance, ensuring contracted SLAs are met, and managing vendor resources independently.

Solid understanding of IT operations best practices, support models (on-call/24x7), incident management, service delivery at scale, and security/access management.

Familiarity with customer service technologies, tools, and infrastructure, with the ability to partner closely with product management and technical stakeholders.

Background in process design and continuous improvement, driving operational efficiency, reliability, and security.

Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to provide clear visibility to leadership and partners.

Ability to thrive in ambiguity, rapidly establish accountability and process discipline, and deliver results in a high-growth environment.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making and performance management.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

The Mobile Automation and Test team enables mobile developers to quickly and confidently deliver high quality and well-tested builds. We build and maintain a reliable and robust suite of automation tools and workflows to test a wide variety of mobile devices across multiple network configurations. Our work addresses the unique challenges of global growth and increasing mobile content consumption.

Ideal Candidate:
We’re seeking a software engineer passionate about building and supporting robust, high-performance CI/CD and test infrastructure for mobile development. In this role, you’ll design and maintain automation tools and workflows that streamline builds, integration, and deployment across diverse mobile devices.

You’ll also develop systems for data collection, visualization, and real-time monitoring to ensure the health and reliability of our pipelines and critical infrastructure. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, collaborating with internal teams, and making a direct impact on developer productivity and mobile app quality, we’d love to hear from you.
 

What you will do:

Design, build, and own the future of the mobile build ecosystem at Netflix, including our CI/CD, packaging, and release pipelines.

Architect and implement scalable, reliable, and performant build and test automation infrastructure that directly improves developer velocity and code quality.

Innovatively create and develop techniques to automate manual activities in our mobile development process.

Operate in a highly cross-functional environment where you can leverage multiple teams to help our partners be successful.

Set direction and build consensus to drive long term positive impact on the mobile engineering ecosystem.

Evangelize and drive adoption of software development best practices in code health, quality and test stability.
 

What you need to have

7+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and maintaining mobile testing infrastructure, including test automation frameworks, device management, and test result reporting at scale.

Proven expertise in building and maintaining tools, frameworks, or infrastructure that improve developer productivity and streamline the mobile development lifecycle.

Deep, hands-on experience with modern CI/CD systems (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Buildkite) and a strong understanding of CI/CD principles for mobile applications.

Experience with at least one modern programming language used in mobile development and testing (e.g. Node.js, Kotlin, Java, Swift, Objective-C).

Expert proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Python, or Ruby, and a strong command of Shell/Bash.

Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to design scalable and maintainable solutions for complex technical challenges.

Experience building internal developer tools or dashboards (e.g., using React, Vue, etc.).

Experience with databases and data visualization for monitoring build health and performance metrics (e.g., MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Grafana).

Our Credit & Collections team is currently looking for a Credit Analyst to play an integral role in supporting and developing a best-in-class credit management environment to ensure smooth and efficient business operations. This newly created position will look to resolve credit-related issues across our B2B Revenue verticals, such as Advertising, Partnerships, and Consumer Products, and partner with multiple cross-functional teams to facilitate Netflix’s ability to grow its revenue while maintaining financial rigor that ensures a prudent and appropriate risk environment. The Credit Analyst will also play a role in establishing, improving, and scaling our credit policies and workflows. 

Responsibilities include assessing the creditworthiness of customers by carefully analyzing a variety of risk factors to ensure collectability and minimize potential for bad debt. Support a large, global, and complex accounts receivable portfolio. Closely collaborate with sales leaders, internal finance, collections, and legal partners to support timely order/deal closure. Work with internal and external auditors and maintain SOX controls in relation to credit approvals and financial data. Respond timely to internal and external customer inquiries, create reports and analyses, and perform other tasks and special projects as needed. Own, manage and drive to completion various process improvement projects, and maintain oversight across the entire team’s process improvement initiatives.

The perfect candidate will be financially astute, detail-oriented, and creative in seeking out solutions and resolutions. They will also have excellent communication skills, be confident in communicating directly with customers and internal business partners, be capable of multitasking, and take the initiative and make decisions to successfully resolve credit-related issues in a timely manner.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

Review, recommend, and update credit lines of new and existing customers based on credit reports, payment trends, industry knowledge, and financial statement analysis

Make appropriate credit decisions to mitigate risk and financial exposure; set appropriate payment terms and understand the impact of contract language on collections

Review orders for release or hold based on payment history and creditworthiness

Keep informed of industry and market developments that could affect the credit portfolio

Work closely with the collections team to reduce exposure to potential bad debt

Interpret various financial reporting sources, such as Dun & Bradstreet

Have a working understanding of SOX controls and understand the importance of maintaining accurate data and a robust control environment

Ensure smooth integration of any additional business verticals or acquired companies into the credit process

Assist in defining, refining, and improving credit strategy, polic,y and process using knowledge of industry-leading practices 

Participate and drive ongoing process improvement, making recommendations and participating and/or leading implementations to improve department efficiency

Provide leadership and ownership across the team’s process improvement initiatives

Actively participate in driving results to meet individual, team, and department objectives

Establish and maintain strong working relationships with customers and business partners from other functional groups at all levels, including executive decision makers

Assist as needed in guiding and supporting other billing & collections staff

QUALITIES WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high volume of transactions and tight deadlines

Deep knowledge and expertise in Credit Review and Credit Management.

Ability to maintain a high level of accuracy in preparing and entering financial information

A great communicator who can cultivate strong cross-functional relationships and communicate effectively with customers and internal teams

Intellectually curious and passionate, our team members ask probing questions, challenge the status quo, make changes to improve processes, and have fun whilst doing it

Organized, detail-oriented, and a speedy learner; you can be successful on our team if you're excited about learning, focused on becoming an expert in the areas you support, and have the drive to succeed

Exemplifies the Netflix Culture.

Ability to deal with ambiguity and successfully execute the required tasks quickly and efficiently

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

5+ years of relevant experience - credit management experience

A bachelor’s Degree in a finance-related field is a plus

Proven ability to work accurately, at pace, and hit deadlines

Excel experience with the ability to navigate data sets.

Experience with other Credit-related 3rd party systems and ticketing tools is a plus.

Knowledge of the Ads business is a plus

Spanish language proficiency a plus since this role will cover LATAM as well

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Transmission Operations Specialist to serve as the architect of our global signal acquisition strategy. As we scale to support high-density concurrent events, we are organizing transmission coordination operations efforts within the Broadcast Operations & Transmission team.

In this role, you will be the "lead of transmission logistics". You will bridge the gap between production and broadcast operations, ensuring that every dollar spent on connectivity delivers maximum reliability and quality. You will take full ownership of the Transmission information in our Transmission book (the single source of truth for our Broadcast Operation) and negotiate the complex landscape of satellite, fiber, and IP contribution vendors to support our productions and our team in the Transmission Operations Center.

*Key Responsibilities*

Strategic Acquisition & Vendor Management

Centralized Procurement: Take ownership of booking satellite time (C-band, Ku-band), fiber circuits, and cellular bonding equipment, transitioning these duties away from third-party production companies to secure preferential rates without markups.

Vendor Relations: Cultivate and maintain high-level partnerships with global transmission vendors (e.g., Tata, SES, AT&T, Lumen, PSSI and NEP) to negotiate volume discounts and ensure priority service during high-demand periods.

Workflow Architecture & Documentation

The Transmission Book: Architect and maintain the "Transmission Book," ensuring it serves as the absolute reference for internal teams within the Transmission Operations Center and external partners regarding signal flow, encoding formats, and encryption.

Operational Standardization: Develop Departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for transmission delivery to reduce overhead for Production and Broadcast Operations teams.

Event Alignment: Validate the transmission data to ensure accuracy for downstream technical teams operating in our Transmission Operations Center (TOC) and Broadcast Control Rooms (BCR).

Cross-Functional Coordination

Transmission Liaison: Act as the central resource for the Broadcast Operations team and the production teams, ensuring there is full alignment on the transmission strategy for each event.

Redundancy Planning: Consult with engineering teams to design robust redundancy strategies for each Netflix Live Event (e.g., satellite backup for fiber paths).

Fiscal Oversight: Track, report, and reconcile vendor invoices, assisting with fiscal budgeting and forecasting to drive cost-efficiency across our transmission portfolio.

Having key relationships with onsite transmission vendors and tech managers in North America, Europe, and Asia.

*Qualifications*

Industry Experience

5+ years of broadcast transmission operations experience, ideally having experience in working with major network organizations both domestically in the United States and internationally in Europe and Asia.

Proven track record in a "Lead" or "Senior" bookings role, capable of managing high-paced live television environments and multitasking across concurrent events.

Technical Expertise

Signal Transport: Deep understanding of the international transmission landscape, including satellite orbits/downlinks, fiber optic networks, and IP transport protocols (SRT, Zixi, SMPTE-2110, RTS/TS).

Compression & Encoding: Extensive knowledge of compression technologies (HEVC, AVC, J2K) and standards conversion (frame rate, HD/ASI, 1080p/720p/UHD) to effectively book the correct resources for TCOs to monitor.

Cloud & Hardware: Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure and ground ingest capabilities to support our hybrid hardware/cloud workflows.

Core Competencies

Financial Acumen: A firm grasp of pricing models from a transmission vendor perspective, with the ability to negotiate contracts that balance cost vs. reliability.

Operational Leadership: Ability to organize and maintain transmission details in the transmission book and serve as an escalation point for complex logistical hurdles.

Why This Role Matters

Currently, our reliance on external teams for booking information creates potential for misalignment and delays. As a Transmission Operations Specialist, you will eliminate these gaps. By centralizing the "logistics of logic," you empower our Transmission Control Operators (TCOs) to focus on signal quality and our Broadcast Control Operators (BCOs) to focus on event execution, creating a cohesive, fail-safe environment for our most critical live moments.

Content & Business Products (CBP) Overview:

The Content & Business Products (CBP) teams are fundamental to Netflix's mission to entertain the world. This organization is responsible for building the products and services that optimize and automate the entire content creation lifecycle, from initial concept and financial planning to global launch and promotion.

CBP is the engine behind "pitch to play," enabling our teams to create, manage, and distribute content at scale. In addition, we build and maintain critical enterprise products that ensure efficient operations across key internal departments, including Finance, Talent, and Customer Support.

Our Team: Studio Production Engineering

Studio Production Engineering builds and operates the technology that powers Netflix’s content journey from pitch to post. Our team delivers robust infrastructure, media management, and workflow solutions for everything from evaluating pitches and managing deals to orchestrating petabytes of production media, scheduling releases, and supporting post-production processes. We enable data-informed decision-making for content executives, support global studio operations, and pioneer new workflows with Generative AI—all while ensuring seamless integration across Netflix and its subsidiaries.

The Role

We recently launched a new ad-supported tier to offer our members more choice in how they consume their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point, while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach audiences that are deeply immersed.

To help us deliver this compelling experience, we’re looking for a highly ambitious, visionary, and experienced Staff Product Designer who will help enable our global Ad tech suite – solidifying Netflix as the premier destination for brands to reach a premium, highly engaged audience. Additionally, you will enable an emerging era of CTV advertising innovation – developing systems that optimize ad performance and engagement.

Your work will also be essential to delivering a delightful, engaging, and highly relevant Ads experience for our Netflix members.

This will be a hybrid role, with a flexible work-from-home schedule. However, onsite attendance will be required as needed by the business - as often as weekly. This role would be best for candidates located in California or in the Pacific time zone, as monthly in-person travel will be required to collaborate with stakeholders and partners in Los Angeles, CA and Los Gatos, CA. That said, we can always make exceptions in location for the right candidate - with flexibility to accommodate candidates at Netflix’s New York City hub.

About Our Team

Our Ads Experience Design team designs the experience, technology, workflows, and capabilities that power Netflix’s advertising business. The Ads Platform Design team designs the tools, features, applications and flows for end-to-end ads lifecycle. Our Ads Platform is comprehensive, best-in-class and rapidly growing, thus enabling highly performant and optimal advertiser-centric experiences. 

Our team’s primary superpower is the ability to design creatively and collaboratively in highly complex environments – from core services that power Netflix’s streaming technology to industry-leading partnership platforms.

You’ll be one of the staff designers who designs the ads workflows and core capabilities that power Netflix’s advertiser experience. More specifically, you’ll be a critical part of one of the most talented and trailblazing advertising design teams in the world.

Why You’ll Love Our Team

We’re big on individual responsibility and smart on process.

Work with stunning, supportive designers on problems that matter.

Flexibility to balance work-from-home and in-office work, so long as you’re able to be onsite for meaningful moments of collaboration.

Freedom and flexibility to craft your own design workflow, while harnessing Netflix’s world-class design system and tooling.

Meaningful financial support for further education and professional growth.

An inclusive environment to help you do your best work and feel genuinely supported.

What You Will Do

Use strong storytelling to create a clear understanding of the UX strategy with cross-functional teams. Apply big-picture thinking to break down ambiguous opportunities into actionable roadmaps.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams spanning sales, marketing, research, data science, product management, and engineering to develop and iterate upon new concepts and facilitate product execution.

Identify, research, design, and execute business differentiating features for Netflix’s advertising suite.

Craft strategic design briefs that provide business, design, and engineering clarity for critical initiatives.

Influence ads business strategy by developing a deep understanding of end-to-end advertising ad tech experience, ensuring our ads platform experience aligns with Netflix’s broader business ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For

A strong, strategic leader able to work across various strategic and tactical levels, rapidly sketching and prototyping.

Innate curiosity to understand needs across the business and develop solutions that address core needs, while thriving in ambiguity and a fast pace.

Work across all stages of the design process (user research, ideation, concept development, validation, wireframing, prototyping, final visual design, and implementation support).

Partner with PMs to craft systematic solutions that connect the dots between user needs, data, business goals, and business strategy. Facilitate collaborative work sessions with all levels of company stakeholders.

Domain familiarity with advertising technology best practices - you’re comfortable with advertising nomenclature, operations, and Live streaming technology.

A passionate energy for great design and amplifying our team culture.

15+ years as a Product Designer (or equivalent experience) in the B2B2C space, leading high-impact initiatives from concept to execution in technical business areas.

5+ years as a Product Designer working specifically in advertising or ads adjacent industries.

A versatile portfolio that showcases deep interaction and problem solving skills, specifically case studies that demonstrate expertise and leadership solving complex business platforms.

Understanding of complex workflows designed to scale across diverse, global operations teams.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills that excite stakeholders and articulate a vision.

Highly organized with meticulous attention to detail (e.g writing documentation to support your design decisions).

Even Better:

Ad tech domain expertise: you’ve developed expertise in delivering advertising technology to a global audience.

Experience working with complex internal systems, data platforms, and highly technical environments (like API platforms).

Experience leading design strategy for B2B2C advertising ecosystem (e.g. influencing product direction through the lens of experience design).

Experience leading cross-functional teams and collaborating with engineering, design, finance, legal, and regional partners.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable with data-driven decision-making.

Excellent project management and organizational skills, able to manage multiple initiatives and priorities simultaneously.

Demonstrated ability to build strong partnerships and work collaboratively across domains and geographies.

Strategic thinker with a bias for action, able to anticipate future needs and drive continuous improvement.

High level of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.

Content Promotion & Distribution Data Engineering team helps enable and inform how we launch, promote, and distribute Netflix content across surfaces, channels, and markets. When a Netflix member opens our app, visits a partner device, or encounters our campaigns off-service, we have a few precious moments to help them choose a story that is right for them at that moment in time. Presenting compelling evidence — artwork, trailers, synopses, notifications, and marketing assets — that authentically represent each title and resonate with the member is essential to this effort. We also work to ensure these experiences scale globally across languages, devices, and distribution channels.

Data and insights are at the heart of how we make these decisions. Our role in Data Engineering is to make this possible: to provide robust, scalable, and well-modeled tabular and multi‑modal data foundations that power analytics, experimentation, and machine learning across the Content Promotion & Distribution ecosystem.

We are looking for a seasoned leader to manage our Content Promotion & Distribution Data Engineering team. 

The Team:

Owns core analytical data models and pipelines that power reporting, decision-support, and experimentation

Builds and operates multi‑modal data foundations (e.g., text, metadata, image, video, and audio) for ML and GenAI model development and evaluation 

Partners closely with Content Promotion and Distribution DSE, AI and Data Platform, Content Engineering to build and steward complex data and media pipelines, and to set best practices for data storage, access, and usage by analytics engineers, data scientists, and software/ML engineers. 

As a leader in this space, you will…

Hire, lead, and develop a stunning team of Data and ML Engineers across a heterogeneous skill set (data, software, and ML engineering).

Own the end-to-end data foundations for Content Promotion & Distribution, spanning:

Traditional data engineering craft: batch/streaming pipelines, data modeling, data warehousing, data quality, and reliability for analytics and experimentation.

Multi‑modal, ML‑ready data: media, text, and rich metadata pipelines that prepare data for training and serving ML and GenAI models.

Partner with cross-functional leaders across Content Promotion & Distribution DSE, AI ML Platform, Content Engineering, Studio Algo, and Marketing to ideate, prioritize, and execute on high-impact data products and tools.

Steer deeply impactful work on foundational data and media products that support Netflix’s Content Promotion & Distribution, spanning agentic solutions, multimodal media understanding, and generation. :

Title launch management and promotional planning

Analytics and optimization for promotional media 

Content media and ML foundations, including scalable access to media assets

Emerging GenAI/ML use cases in promotion and creative automation (e.g., Synthetic voice, machine translation, etc.)

Provide technical vision and strategy for how we model, store, transform, and serve both structured and multi‑modal data to power analytics, experimentation, and ML at scale.

Balance near-term and long-term needs, from ongoing support of stakeholder quarterly goals to multi-year investments in infrastructure and “paved paths” for ML/GenAI research and productionization.

Set and raise the technical bar for data engineering craft in this space, including:

Scalable and interpretable analytical data models

Reliable batch and streaming pipelines

Well-governed, discoverable, and reusable ML feature and media datasets

Drive alignment in ambiguity by clarifying trade-offs, making principled decisions, and bringing diverse partners along a shared roadmap.

Grow and mentor the team through thoughtful observation, coaching, and courageous, honest feedback; help engineers navigate career development across data, software, and ML engineering paths.

Build both software and social glue across a wide network of stakeholders—VPs, Directors, Managers, and ICs—enabling decisions that affect hundreds of millions of members and major content and marketing investments.

This role may be for you if…

You have been leading data engineering teams for 7+ years, including managing managers and larger, heterogeneous teams (data, software, ML engineers) or shared-resource teams.

You have a proven track record leading innovative, influential data engineering work in complex business domains, ideally involving multimodal media data marketing/promotion, content/media, experimentation, and or ML/AI-driven products.

You are comfortable owning the technical quality of both:

Analytics-focused data engineering (ETL/ELT, modeling, warehousing, data quality), and

ML-focused data engineering (feature pipelines, media and multi‑modal data preparation, training/serving data sets), even if you are not writing production code every day.

You are a crisp communicator who develops strong relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders—technical and non-technical—and can drive alignment across Director/Manager-level partners.

You are deeply invested in creating an inclusive team environment and helping each team member grow; you care about psychological safety, diversity of perspectives, and clear, actionable feedback.

You have experience leading a team of shared resources, effectively prioritizing and sequencing work across multiple domains and stakeholder groups.

You are an experienced partner for ML Platform, Content Engineering, and Data Platform teams; you can advocate from a data engineering perspective and align on shared components and standards.

You have deep technical expertise in one or more aspects of data engineering, such as:

Media or other large-scale, multi‑modal asset processing pipelines

Building ML- and experimentation-ready data products

Data warehousing and dimensional/semantic data modeling

Batch and streaming data processing

Media or other large-scale, multi‑modal asset processing pipelines

Building ML- and experimentation-ready data products

You’re comfortable with a collection of Big Data and cloud-based tech (e.g., S3 or similar object storage, Spark or other distributed processing frameworks, modern data warehouses, workflow orchestration), and are able to make sound architecture and infrastructure tradeoffs.

The Ads Integration Engineering team is committed to accelerating product adoption at scale by streamlining complex and repeatable integrations with external partners and platforms. Our mission is to deliver standardized, paved-path integrations that unlock operational value and accelerate time to market, acting as the primary technical liaison to ensure seamless implementation and robust support. 

Responsibilities

Build a deep understanding of the Netflix Ads Stack to serve as a platform expert capable of navigating technical ambiguity and selecting the most efficient integration paths aligned with long-term product vision.

Drive the end-to-end integration lifecycle including implementation, configuration, and validation by working exclusively within established systems and tooling owned and built by core Software Engineering (SWE) teams.

Serve as the voice of the customer and primary technical point of contact for external partners, representing their technical needs and constraints in internal requirements discussions to ensure the product roadmap accounts for real-world integration challenges

Provide hands-on technical support for integrations, while owning the launch monitoring and stability of mature product integrations to ensure a successful transition to live usage.

Act as the internal quarterback for critical incidents (SEV1/SEV2). Manage communication between the client and Product/Engineering during outages.

Manage proactive technical communications with all stakeholders and contribute to integration-specific codebase changes (such as debugging, configuration, or observability improvements) in close collaboration with the responsible SWE teams.

Qualifications

Ad Tech & Tech Proficiency

Deep experience in digital media or ad tech, specifically in roles involving hands-on work with CAPI platforms, audience onboarding, and data integrators. Exposure to advertising measurement partners and campaign activation workflows is a plus.

Strong understanding of Conversions API (CAPI) integrations across major platforms (Meta, Google, Snap, Pinterest, LiveRamp) and best practices for audience mapping, onboarding, and activation. Familiarity with tag management systems like Google Tag Manager is highly desirable.

Hands-on experience with data integrators and ETL pipelines used in audience onboarding and measurement workflows. Proficiency in SQL for data validation and debugging; scripting experience in Python or Java..

Proficiency in Java or Python and advanced SQL knowledge are required for hands-on technical tasks, including data preparation, dealing with log-level data and debugging.

API Mastery: Extensive experience implementing, troubleshooting, and debugging REST APIs using tools like curl, Postman, or similar.

Cloud Architecture: Deep understanding of at least one public cloud computing platform.

Code Comprehension: Ability to read and debug code to contribute minor, integration-specific changes (e.g., small pull requests, observability improvements) to existing codebases.

Technical Support and Client training Expertise: Hands-on experience providing technical support, resolving blockers, and performing system validation to ensure successful integration launches.

Embrace Emerging Technologies: There is immense opportunity to leverage AI tools to improve our ability to provide world-class support, documentation, and integration with our partners. We would love to see experience with leveraging these tools for real-world results in this space. 

Partnership & Communication

Platform Mastery & Curiosity: A high degree of curiosity and the ability to rapidly build a deep understanding of the Netflix Ads Stack to serve as an authoritative resident expert, providing the technical guidance needed to steer partners and internal teams through complex implementations. 

Technical Translation: Proven ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into concrete technical integration plans and explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Partner Advocacy: Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to manage technical relationships and effectively represent partner needs to internal product and engineering teams.

Strategic Problem Solving: Ability to navigate technical ambiguity to identify the most efficient solutions that align with the long-term product vision.

A culture of experimentation enables Netflix to continuously evolve and improve our products, delivering more joy to existing members and attracting new members from around the globe. Because experimentation is so pervasive at Netflix, we continually enable new capabilities and onboard new initiatives to the platform with close cross-functional collaboration with our Data Science partners.

At the nerve center of experimentation at Netflix is our internal, Netflix-wide, Experimentation Platform, responsible for democratizing trustworthy experiments across the company and enabling new capabilities across the company. We are looking to expand the number of full-stack data science faculty on the team to better support experimentation best-practice and drive further innovation in data science tooling.

Responsibilities:

Work closely with data science and engineering stakeholders to act as a strategic thought partner and onboard new workflows.

Design, build, operate, and maintain mathematics and engineering implementations of methodologies employed by the experimentation platform, as well as facilitating data science partner contributions.

Maintain existing inference related data and analysis pipelines, including compute clusters and API services.

Develop new tooling to meet emerging experimentation-related business needs.

Proactively work with the rest of the XP team (including other full-stack data scientists) to ensure that our platform continues to deliver trustworthy and useful analysis results.

Qualifications:

Advanced degree (PhD or Masters) in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative field

3+ years experience with statistics / inference, ideally in an experimentation context.

3+ years experience with data science languages, ideally including Python and SQL.

3+ years building and operating applications serving internal or external production traffic

Ability to translate mathematical concepts into clean maintainable engineering code.

Curiosity to learn new statistics, methods, optimization techniques, etc.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Able to bring clarity and life to ambiguous problems.
